title: Machine Learning Engineer, Ads Ranking
description:
## About SmartNews
SmartNews is a leading global information and news discovery company dedicated to delivering quality information to the people who need it. Thanks to our unique machine-learning technology and relationships with more than 3,000 global publisher partners, we provide news that matters to millions of users.
Founded in 2012 in Tokyo, SmartNews also has offices in Osaka (Kansai Office), Palo Alto, New York and Singapore.
If you share our vision and are passionate about our mission, we encourage you to apply!
## The Team
The Ads Ranking Team is dedicated to empowering the SmartNews ads business by developing state-of-art ranking systems and advanced product solutions that ensures the highest relevance, profitability, and sustainability of our ad offerings. By applying a blend of engineering expertise and business insights, we strive to enhance ad performance and revenue, meeting and exceeding the expectations of our advertisers. We are looking for talented engineers to join us in building the next-generation ad systems and products that will support our rapid and ambitious growth.
## Responsibilities
• Develop and optimize core algorithms to generate relevant ads, driving the growth of a profitable ad ecosystem. This includes areas such as targeting, ranking, bidding and auction.
• Work closely with backend engineers to develop a highly scalable ranking and delivery system, ensuring high performance and reliability.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, product specialists and sales, building product solutions to solve advertisers’ pain points and meet their needs.
Requirements
Minimum requirements
• BS degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (Physics, Mathematics, etc.).
• Solid programming fundamentals with experience in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, C++).
• Familiarity with machine learning concepts and algorithms, with a strong interest in applying them to real-world problems.
• Good problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn and adapt to complex systems.
• Strong analytical thinking and basic understanding of statistical concepts.
• Proficiency in business-level English.
Nice to have experiences/skills
• M.S. or Ph.D. in a relevant major.
• Proven research skills, demonstrated through publications in top conferences or involvement in impactful research projects.
• Internship or project experience related to large-scale ML systems.
• Basic knowledge or interest in the digital ad ecosystem.

title: Research Scientist – Molecular Diagnostics
description:
Our Bosch Research team occupies a critical position between academic research and product development, distinguishing us from many other companies. We engage with academia, incubate ideas, advance them to the prototype stage, and collaborate with development teams in our business units to support product development based on our research outcomes. We are seeking a research scientist with a strong academic background, proven industry experience, and a passion for tackling complex, real-world problems in molecular diagnostics.
Our R&D center is located in Sunnyvale, CA, USA. This is in the heart of Silicon Valley in close proximity to Stanford University and UC Berkeley. The candidate will be a key contributor to our research and development efforts, from conceptualization to the creation of novel technologies. This is an exciting opportunity for someone with industry experience who is eager to make a significant impact in the field of molecular sensors and biotechnology.
Responsibilities:
• Identify, incubate, and translate cutting-edge academic research into functional, scalable proof-of-concept technologies in molecular diagnostics and biosensing.
• Lead hands-on development and testing of prototype diagnostic systems, integrating microfluidics, electrochemical sensing, soft electronics, and chip-scale nanofabrication.
• Collaborate closely with internal business units, engineering teams, and external academic partners (e.g., Stanford, UC Berkeley) to transition early-stage research into commercially viable product pipelines.
• Design and execute advanced experiments for single-molecule detection, assay integration, and sample-to-answer cartridge performance.
• Protect innovation through patent filings while contributing high-impact scientific publications and technical documentation.
• Serve as a subject matter expert in biosensors and bioelectronics, advising multidisciplinary teams on technical feasibility, risk mitigation, and system architecture.
• Education: PhD in a relevant field (e.g., Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Bioengineering, Physics, or a related discipline)
• Industry Experience: 3-5 years of previous industry experience in a relevant biotechnology company. We highly value experience in translating academic ideas into real-world products.
• Molecular Diagnostics Expertise: Proven experience in building real-world solutions in the biotechnology sector, particularly in single molecule detection and instrumentation for molecular diagnostics.
• Integrated Systems Experience: Demonstrated experience with integrated molecular diagnostic platforms, such as cartridge design, on-chip sample-prep, and electronics.
• Soft Electronics: experience with soft electronics for applications in biosensing.
• Micro/Nanofabrication: experience with chip design and process development for applications in biosensing.
• Electrochemical Sensing: experience with electrochemical systems and biosensors.
• Biochemistry: familiarity with the principles of biochemistry.
• Proven track record of scientific accomplishment/patent filings
• Soft skills: highly motivated and passionate about developing new technologies and products; strong documentation, oral and interpersonal skills, experience working in a multidisciplinary team.
This is a U.S. based position, domestic relocation and local sponsorship considered on a per candidate basis.
The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $150,000 - $170,000. Within the range, individual pay is determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, work experience and job knowledge, complexity of the role, job location, etc. Your Recruiter can share more details about the specific salary range for this position during the interview process.
In addition to your base salary, Bosch offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, and vision plans; health savings accounts (HSA); flexible spending accounts; 401(K) retirement plans with an employer match; wellness programs; life insurance; short- and long-term disability insurance; paid time off; parental leave, adoption assistance; and reimbursement of education expenses.
Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans.
*Bosch adheres to Federal, State, and Local laws regarding drug-testing. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a drug screen and background check. Candidates who have been offered the position must pass both screenings before their start date.

title: Software Engineer (Salesforce)
Data Scientist | Modeling
description:
Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.
Our team builds machine learning models for some of the largest health plans in the country to identify and audit claims errors from simple errors to outright fraud. Large insurance payers receive tens of millions of claims each year, of which they only are able to audit less than 10%. Our claim selection models help with selecting the right set of claims to audit and recover hundreds of millions of dollars each year reducing wasted medical spend. We have made significant progress already, with models that significantly outperform even selection by human experts but there are still many improvements to be made.
We are looking for a Sr. Data Scientist | Modeling to advance our models further. In addition to building best-in-class models, this person will create technical frameworks and tools to help the team achieve greater scale and improved business outcomes.
## What You’ll Do:
Master Claim Audits: Dive into various clinical and coding audits, unpacking the data that drives audit decisions, and understanding past outcomes.
Model Advancement: Curate labeled data, hypothesize new features, and develop ML models that target claims for audit with even greater precision.
Optimize Impact: Measure model performance rigorously, translating outcomes into operational insights and recommendations for our clients.
Tame Complexity: Work with vast, nuanced data pipelines derived from intricate business workflows—often unclean and undefined—to refine them for robust modeling.
Drive Team Success: Enhance data pipelines, modeling infrastructure, and team tools to level up our capabilities and decision-making efficiency.
Grow with Healthcare: Build expertise in healthcare data and make an impact on the industry. Engage with clients and internal experts to refine model insights, ensuring alignment with real business needs.
## What You Bring:
You enjoy solving real-world business problems involving data-driven optimization and ML modeling - and have been doing that successfully for a while.
You are comfortable measuring and optimizing the direct business impact of work.
You are experienced with SQL, handling large-scale data, and are comfortable with at least one programming language (Python, R, etc.).
You have experience building ML models using modern ML approaches like Neural Nets or Tree-ensembles from scratch for new applications - making decisions relating to which supervised labels to use, the metric to optimize for, and the features likely to be useful
## What We Offer
• Work from anywhere in the US! Machinify is digital-first.
• Top Medical/Dental/Vision offerings
• FSA/HSA
• Tuition reimbursement
• Competitive salary, 401(k) with company match
• Unlimited PTO
• Additional health and wellness benefits and perks
• Flexible and trusting environment where you’ll feel empowered to do your best work
The salary for this position is based on an array of factors unique to each candidate: Such as years and depth of experience, set skills, certifications, etc. We are hiring for different levels and the base salary can range from $180k-$230k+ based on your assessed level. Compensation also includes meaningful equity, healthcare, unlimited PTO, and more.
## Equal Employment Opportunity at Machinify
We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. title: AI Solution Engineer
description:
## AI Solution Engineer
## Work Type: Part-time.
Schedule: U.S. business hours (CST preferred).
## Location: 100% Remote.
## About the Role
We are looking for an AI Automation & Integration Engineer to maintain, optimize, and expand our existing automation ecosystem while developing new AI-powered features and intelligent workflows.
The company currently operates on an interconnected technology stack that includes Trello, a custom-built in-house CRM, Jotform, Zapier, and Make. The initial priority for this role will be to understand how these systems work together, troubleshoot existing integrations, identify inefficiencies, and improve the reliability of our current workflows.
Beyond maintenance, this person will help build the next generation of our internal operations by transforming manual, multi-step business processes into intelligent workflows powered by AI agents and automation. The goal is to create systems where agents can execute tasks, coordinate information, interact with external tools, and escalate decisions to humans when necessary.
This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can work independently, understand inherited systems, make sound architectural decisions, and take AI-powered solutions from concept to production.
## Key Responsibilities
## 1. Automation Debugging & System Maintenance
Take ownership of existing automations and integrations across Trello, the custom CRM, Jotform, Zapier, and Make.
Diagnose workflow failures, identify root causes, and implement sustainable fixes rather than temporary workarounds.
Evaluate existing automation architecture and identify opportunities to improve performance, reliability, and maintainability.
Recommend whether existing workflows should be optimized, repaired, or rebuilt.
## 2. Systems Integration & API Development
Build and maintain integrations between project management, CRM, form platforms, and external applications.
Work with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication mechanisms, rate limits, retries, and data mapping.
Analyze undocumented or custom-built systems by reviewing schemas, existing implementations, and available technical resources.
Ensure accurate and consistent data synchronization across connected platforms.
## 3. AI Agents & Context Engineering
Develop AI-powered agents capable of executing multi-step business processes with minimal human intervention.
Implement context retrieval, memory management, conversation state, and relevant information injection.
Optimize context windows and retrieval strategies to maintain accuracy and consistency across complex workflows.
Design human-in-the-loop mechanisms for reviewing outputs, approving sensitive actions, and escalating exceptions.
## 4. Workflow Automation & Orchestration
Audit, maintain, rebuild, and extend workflows using Zapier and Make.
Leverage n8n or comparable orchestration platforms when they provide a more effective solution.
Coordinate AI models, APIs, external tools, and business logic across multi-step workflows.
Design task decomposition, execution sequences, dependencies, error handling, and recovery mechanisms.
## 5. AI Feature Development
Build new internal tools, integrations, and automation features that support business operations.
Develop maintainable solutions using Python, TypeScript, or comparable programming languages.
Integrate LLMs and third-party APIs based on performance, reliability, complexity, and cost considerations.
Translate operational requirements into practical technical solutions.
## 6. Testing, Evaluation & Optimization
Test AI agents against representative business scenarios and measurable performance criteria.
Identify failure patterns and improve accuracy, consistency, response times, and overall reliability.
Validate structured outputs, tool calling, and automated decision-making.
Continuously refine prompts, workflows, and agent behavior based on real-world performance.
## 7. Deployment & Production Monitoring
Take solutions from prototype through testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
Monitor production workflows, troubleshoot failures, and implement safeguards.
Maintain version control, technical documentation, and code quality standards.
Apply appropriate security practices when handling credentials, API keys, and sensitive business information.
## 8. Continuous Technical Improvement
Stay current with emerging AI models, agent frameworks, orchestration tools, and context engineering practices.
Evaluate new technologies and determine their practical value for the company's existing infrastructure.
Identify opportunities to replace repetitive manual processes with reliable, AI-assisted workflows.
## Required Qualifications & Technical Skills
Professional Experience:3–5 years of professional software engineering experience, including maintaining, debugging, and extending systems originally developed by other engineers.
AI & Intelligent Automation:Hands-on experience building AI-powered applications, intelligent automations, or agent-based workflows.
Debugging & Troubleshooting:Proven ability to take ownership of inherited automations, trace failures across interconnected platforms, and explain technical issues and their root causes.
Systems Integration:Experience integrating CRM, project management, and form platforms through REST APIs, webhooks, and custom integrations.
Programming:Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript, including writing maintainable code and troubleshooting complex application issues.
Databases & Data Modeling: Experience with SQL, database structures, data modeling, and designing reliable data synchronization between systems.
Workflow Automation:Practical, hands-on experience with both Zapier and Make is required.
LLM Integration:Experience integrating LLM provider APIs, structured outputs, tool calling, and prompt engineering into real-world applications.
Context Engineering:Understanding of memory management, retrieval, conversation state, and context optimization for multi-step AI workflows.
Software Engineering Practices: Familiarity with Git, GitHub, API design, testing, debugging, and collaborative development.
Architecture & Technical Judgment:Ability to evaluate existing systems, identify inefficiencies, and determine when to optimize, repair, or rebuild.
Production Experience:Ability to take solutions from initial development through testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Security Awareness:Understanding of secure credential management, API key protection, least-privilege access, and responsible handling of sensitive information.
Autonomy: Comfortable making technical decisions, prioritizing competing requirements, and delivering results with limited supervision.
## Communication & Problem-Solving Skills
Strong written English communication skills. C1 or High.
Ability to conduct technical discovery and ask the right questions before proposing or developing solutions.
Comfortable translating operational challenges into technical requirements and practical implementation plans.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, particularly when working with undocumented or inherited systems.
Understands when AI-generated outputs require human verification, approval, or escalation.
Able to communicate technical limitations, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders.
Self-directed, accountable, and proactive in following up on blockers and pending decisions.
## Nice-to-Have Qualifications
Experience with Trello, Jotform, or comparable project management and form platforms.
Experience administering or integrating custom-built CRM platforms.
Familiarity with agent frameworks and orchestration libraries such as LangGraph and LangChain.
Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and connecting AI agents to external services.
Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.
Experience with AI evaluation frameworks, observability, tracing, guardrails, and automated testing.
Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure.
Experience with MLOps, CI/CD pipelines, and scalable application deployment.
Familiarity with React and modern application development environments.

Minimum 5 paid days off annually, plus US holidays.

title: AI Business Development Representative (m/w/d) | KI-Agenten für die Industrie |
description:
Für neue Interessenten bist du die erste Ansprechperson bei elunic und zeigst ihnen, was ein eluna-Agent in ihren Abläufen im Büro erledigt. Nach dem ersten Abschluss gibst du an unsere AI Sales Consultants ab, mit wachsender Erfahrung betreust du deine Kunden später selbst weiter. Du arbeitest remote.
## Was du tatsächlich tust
Du findest und qualifizierst neue Kunden. Zielkunden und Entscheider recherchierst du selbst, etwa über LinkedIn und HubSpot. Vom Erstkontakt bis zur ersten Websession bist du ihr Gegenüber.
Du zeigst eluna am konkreten Fall. In Demo-Terminen spielst du durch, was ein Agent beim Kunden erledigt, zum Beispiel eine Service-Anfrage, eine Ersatzteilbestellung oder ein Angebot. Dabei übersetzt du die Technik in Nutzen für sein Team.
Du holst den ersten Abschluss und gibst dann ab. Danach übernimmt unser AI Sales Consulting. Deine Empfehlungen für weitere Anwendungsfälle sind die Grundlage für die weitere Kundenentwicklung.
Ein Ergebnis aus einem Kundenprojekt: Eine Service-Anfrage braucht jetzt 45 Sekunden, vorher waren es 25 Minuten. Bei Ausnahmen entscheidet ein Mensch.
## Das bist du
Du hast schon etwas angestoßen und zu Ende gebracht. Ein Kundensegment, ein Prozess, ein eigenes Projekt, auch gegen Widerstände. Welche Station, ist uns weniger wichtig als das Muster.
Du findest auf jeder Ebene den passenden Ton. Ob Maschinenbedienerin oder Werkleiter, du wechselst ohne Mühe zwischen den Ebenen.
Du verstehst, warum KI einen Unterschied macht. Programmieren musst du nicht. Wie KI-Lösungen funktionieren, weißt du schon oder eignest es dir schnell an.
Was du wirklich brauchst: Deutsch auf verhandlungssicherem Niveau, weil du mit Kunden im Termin sitzt.
Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Informatikstudium, Berufsjahre oder Erfahrung in der Industrie setzen wir nicht voraus. Das Industriewissen lernst du bei uns.
## Ehrlich: Was dich hier erwartet
Wir arbeiten KI-first, in allen Rollen. KI nimmt dir Routine ab, der Anspruch an deine Arbeit steigt dadurch. Damit alle mitkommen, steht Lernzeit fest im Kalender.
Deine Kunden suchst du dir selbst. Recherche und Erstkontakt gehören genauso zur Rolle wie Demos. Unklare Situationen und wechselnde Prioritäten sind Teil des Jobs.
Ehrlich gesagt passen wir eher nicht zusammen, wenn du feste Vorgaben von außen brauchst oder KI für ein Thema für später hältst.
## Was du bekommst
KI-Werkzeuge ohne Formular, dazu unsere eigenen Agenten. Neue Modelle probierst du direkt im Projekt aus.
Beteiligung über die Übergabe hinaus: Am Erfolg der Anwendungsfälle, die du empfiehlst, bist du prozentual beteiligt.
Echte Aktien: Mitarbeiteraktien der elunic AG für alle im Team.
9 Stunden Lernzeit pro Woche und bis zu 600 € im Jahr für Kurse und Konferenzen.
Dein Rhythmus: Teilzeit und Elternzeit möglich, Arbeitszeiten flexibel.
Dazu: EGYM Wellpass, Jobrad, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, Teamevents und Workations.
## So bewirbst du dich
Kein Anschreiben, Lebenslauf oder LinkedIn-Profil reicht. Am meisten freut uns ein Link auf etwas, das du gebaut hast. KI darfst du dabei nutzen.
Video-Interview. Ein paar kurze Fragen, wann es dir passt.
Kennenlern-Call. Über dich, die Rolle und deine Fragen.
Gespräch mit einem Gründer. Wohin elunic will, aus erster Hand.
Use Case. Eine echte Aufgabe, mit den Werkzeugen aus dem Job.
Unsicher, ob es passt? Mach den AI Harness-Check oder lass deinen eigenen Agenten prüfen, ob wir zu dir passen.
Über elunic. Wir bringen KI in den industriellen Mittelstand, mit rund 60 Leuten im Kernteam und einem festen Netz aus Partnern. Mit eluna bauen wir KI-Agenten, die im Büro unserer Kunden Vorgänge erledigen, von der Service-Anfrage bis zum Angebot.
Mehr über uns auf elunic.com/karriere

title: Software Engineer
description:
## ABOUT UNRAVEL CARBON
Unravel Carbon is an enterprise software that helps companies track and reduce their carbon emissions, focusing on Asia, based in Singapore.
It is the first AI-powered decarbonization platform in Asia that converts any company's accounting data into full supply chain carbon data in seconds, generates climate solutions automatically and auto-populates regulatory disclosure reports.
We aim to accelerate the participation of all companies, big and small, in the global fight against climate change. And we want to do it the 21st century way—autonomous, painless, and beautiful.
Unravel consists of a team of software engineers, data scientists, founders and climate experts with a passion to solve the world's most pressing issue—climate change. Collectively, our leadership team has launched and invested in multiple companies, and are now combining their experience and knowledge here at Unravel.
We are backed by some of the world's best funds and investors such as Y Combinator, Sequoia.
Unravel was founded in Q4/2021 with headquarters in Singapore.
## ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a full-stack Software Engineer in Japan to help build Unravel Carbon's product for a growing base of customers across Asia and beyond. This is a hands-on, full-stack engineering role: you will work across the data layer, backend and frontend, lead projects end to end on our product roadmap, solve hard problems across the platform and ship production code.
Japan is one of our key markets. Our customers there include large enterprises, many of them manufacturers, measuring emissions across their full value chain, as well as sustainability consultancies that deliver our platform to their clients. With reporting becoming mandatory and SSBJ disclosures coming in, enterprises need audit-ready numbers rather than estimates. You will bring the perspective of these customers into our engineering team, and help turn local requirements into product capabilities that work for users everywhere.
## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Build and ship the product
• Design, build and ship production features across the platform, including our carbon calculation engine, data ingestion pipelines and AI-powered workflows.
• Take ownership of complex problems end to end, from scoping and technical design through to delivery and iteration.
• Develop integrations with customers' accounting and ERP systems.
• Support global users and local requirements
• Take ownership of product localization and internationalization: multi-language support, accurate sustainability terminology, and the details that matter to local users, such as input behaviour and local conventions for presenting data.
• Design flexible ways to support local regulatory and reporting requirements, such as country-specific emission factors, calculation methods and disclosure formats, so that each new market builds on the last.
• Bring the customer's voice into the product
• Join conversations with customers and partners as a technical expert, particularly in Japan, helping to scope new requirements and answer technical questions.
• Translate customer insights into product decisions and well-defined work for the engineering team.
• Work closely with our commercial teams so that customer feedback reaches the product quickly and accurately.
## ABOUT YOU
• You are a full-stack engineer and a problem solver at heart, with strong fundamentals and the ability to write, debug and reason about code independently, and you take pride in building software that real users rely on.
• You are product-minded: you care about why something is being built, not only how, and you enjoy learning directly from customers.
• You communicate clearly in both Japanese and English, in writing and in conversation.
• You have a sharp eye for detail. Our customers rely on our numbers for regulatory disclosure, so accuracy matters.
• You see the work of helping companies measure and reduce their emissions as meaningful.
• Required skills:
• Python backend development (Flask, Django). Backend development in other languages/frameworks can be considered too
• Front End Web development (ReactJS)
• SQL and NoSQL databases (Postgres, DuckDB, MongoDB)
• Strong practical programming fundamentals, including common data structures and problem-solving
• Optional skills:
• Experience building data-intensive products
• Experience building with LLMs or agentic workflows
• Integrations with accounting or ERP systems
• Cloud services (AWS, GCP or Azure)
• Familiarity with carbon accounting (GHG Protocol) or sustainability reporting frameworks
## YOUR WORK STYLE
• Ownership-oriented: You take projects from idea to production and see them through. In a small team, you step up without being asked.
• Methodical & thorough: You investigate problems systematically, trace data issues back to their root cause, and document your findings clearly.
• Proactive communicator: You surface issues early to customers, to teammates and upwards, rather than waiting for problems to escalate.
• Bridge-builder: You thrive at the intersection of technical and business teams. You translate between engineers who think in APIs and sustainability managers who think in carbon tonnes.
## YOUR PREFERRED BACKGROUND
• A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or equivalent practical experience
• 2+ years of full-stack software engineering experience at a product company, building and maintaining software used by real customers
• A track record of growing scope and responsibility across your roles
• Native or near-native Japanese (reading, writing, speaking). Non-native speakers who have worked directly with Japanese companies in Japanese will also be considered
• Business-level proficiency in English
• Start-up experience is a plus
We welcome candidates across a range of seniority. More important than years of experience is finding the right fit: someone who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, takes ownership and is excited to grow with us.
## WHAT WE OFFER YOU
The opportunity to get in at the early stage of our market expansion and to shape how Unravel Carbon serves customers in Japan and around the world.
We offer an exciting challenge for a purpose-driven person who thoroughly enjoys learning and takes ownership in a multicultural, semi-virtual, and pioneering organisation.
We nurture a culture that allows you to thrive, where your skills can be honed, and your ideas will be heard, and where collaboration across teams and with global partners is the default.

Recently the world has changed so we are changing with it. We’re embracing new ways of working and are constantly adapting our practices to ensure that wherever you are working from, you feel a part of the team and have everything you need to work comfortably. We are a remote-first company, Pushies can choose to work remotely or from our Downtown Vancouver office.

Push Operations welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process.

title: [Contractor] Pessoa Engenheira de Software Fullstack - Sênior
description:
Cheesecake Labs é parceira de IA, dados e engenharia de produto para organizações consolidadas e em fase de escala que enfrentam sistemas legados, dados fragmentados, pressão por IA ou capacidade de engenharia limitada.
Nossos serviços incluem Implementação de IA, Modernização de Aplicações, Data & Analytics, Product Engineering, Entrega Acelerada por IA e Times de Engenharia Integrados. Entregamos workflows agênticos em 8 a 12 semanas e modernizamos aplicações em 5 a 10 meses, em vez de 2 anos. Também construímos bases de dados confiáveis e produtos digitais feitos para escalar. Nosso ciclo de desenvolvimento de software agêntico acelera a execução, enquanto engenheiros experientes se integram aos times dos clientes para trazer profundidade técnica, segurança e clareza de ownership.
Membro do Claude Partner Network da Anthropic. Entre nossos parceiros de tecnologia estão Databricks, Snowflake, dbt e AWS.
Em mais de 13 anos, a Cheesecake Labs construiu mais de 300 produtos para clientes como Eurasia Group, MoneyGram, World Bank, Stellar, Wedgewood, PepsiCo, Merck, Sodexo e Mercado Libre.
## Detalhes da contratação
• Modelo de contractor, por projeto
• Pagamento em USD por hora
• 100% remoto
• Alocação flexível, conforme a disponibilidade de projetos e o fit
• As oportunidades podem variar em duração, escopo e dedicação semanal, de acordo com as necessidades dos clientes
Algumas oportunidades podem começar imediatamente.
Outras podem ser ativadas conforme novos projetos entrarem no nosso pipeline.
## A história por trás desta vaga
Muitas vagas de engenharia de IA ainda giram em torno de experimentos, protótipos isolados ou pesquisa. Esta não é uma delas.
Na Cheesecake Labs, construímos software e soluções com IA para empresas reais, com usuários reais, restrições reais e prazos reais. Nossos squads são pequenos e seniores, e entregam em semanas e meses, não em anos.
Hoje, agentes de IA escrevem a maior parte do nosso código. Esta vaga é para quem decide como as coisas são construídas, direciona os agentes, verifica o resultado e responde por ele diante do cliente.
Estamos buscando uma pessoa Engenheira de Software Sênior: alguém que assume um projeto de cliente desde a primeira conversa de escopo até a produção, e que lida com as decisões de negócio, produto e técnica no caminho. Quando o projeto tem PM, a direção de produto fica com essa pessoa e você é a contraparte técnica dela. Quando não tem, você recebe o problema direto do founder ou do cliente.
## Como é esta vaga na prática
Esta não é uma vaga de “receber tickets e implementar features”. Também não é uma vaga de “escrever cada linha na mão”.
## Em um projeto típico, você pode:
• Rodar o nosso Spec Driven, nosso fluxo de desenvolvimento orientado a specs: reunir contexto, especificar, planejar, implementar por meio de agentes de IA, revisar e fechar o ciclo.
• Transformar um problema de negócio do cliente em um desenho técnico e em uma spec que um agente de IA consiga executar e que você consiga verificar.
• Trabalhar com PM, designer e o squad para entender o que deve ser construído, ou receber os requisitos direto do founder ou do cliente quando não há PM.
• Participar de conversas com o cliente sobre objetivos, escopo e trade-offs técnicos, e mantê-lo atualizado por escrito ao longo do caminho.
• Direcionar agentes de IA (Claude Code, Cursor ou similares) para implementar a partir da sua spec. Escrever código à mão é a exceção, não o padrão.
• Revisar o que os agentes produzem, combinando loops automatizados de revisão com a sua própria checagem de arquitetura e comportamento, e responder por 100% do que é entregue.
• Tomar as decisões de arquitetura. A IA executa, você decide.
• Entregar e iterar, e depois fechar o ciclo devolvendo decisões e edge cases ao contexto do projeto, para que a próxima spec comece mais bem informada.
• Usar todos os dias o nosso harness compartilhado (skills, agentes e loops de revisão), melhorá-lo e devolver o que funciona, para que todos os squads se beneficiem.
• Trabalhar dentro das regras de cada cliente sobre o uso de IA (veja Como usamos IA aqui).
Alguns projetos pesam mais na arquitetura. Outros, nas conversas com o cliente. A maioria mistura os dois. Você trabalha com bastante autonomia, e conta com um Engineering Manager e com o squad quando precisar.
## O que costuma funcionar bem por aqui
## Quem se destaca nesta vaga costuma:
• Ter construído e entregue produtos de software reais de ponta a ponta, com JS/Typescript, e/ou Python, e conseguir explicar as decisões que tomou.
• Já usar agentes de IA todos os dias para projetar, construir, depurar e pesquisar, e conseguir mostrar o que construiu.
• Pensar em specs: transformar ambiguidade em definições estruturadas e testáveis.
• Ter mentalidade full-stack. Backend, frontend, IA ou produto podem ser o seu forte, e você circula entre as camadas quando o projeto precisa.
• Verificar antes de dizer “pronto” e deixar claro o que foi e o que não foi verificado.
• Trazer problemas cedo, já com opções, e compartilhar o que aprendeu com o time.
• Atuar bem com alta autonomia, pouca burocracia e ciclos rápidos de feedback, em um formato 100% remoto.
## Talvez esta vaga não seja para você se
## Só para ser transparente:
• Você precisa de requisitos detalhados ou de direção constante antes de começar.
• Você vê a IA como ferramenta de apoio, ou prefere escrever a maior parte do código à mão.
• Você se sente confortável entregando resultado de IA que não verificou.
• Você prefere funções focadas só em implementação, sem conversa com cliente ou com o negócio.
• Você não se sente à vontade conversando direto com clientes ou lidando com problemas ambíguos.
• Você tende a ficar em silêncio entre o kickoff e a entrega.
• Você prefere prioridades estáveis a iteração rápida e alta ownership.
Não há nada de errado em nenhuma dessas preferências. Só não é assim que a gente trabalha.
## Uma última coisa
Para participar deste processo seletivo, você precisa:
• Ter um registro empresarial válido no seu país (CNPJ, VAT, EIN ou equivalente).
• Ter uma conta bancária apta a receber pagamentos em dólar (USD).
• Poder emitir invoices (notas fiscais ou equivalente) conforme necessário.
Esses requisitos são necessários para a contratação como prestador de serviços (contractor) e para o processamento dos pagamentos.
## Não tem certeza se atende a todos os requisitos?
## Tudo bem.
Sabemos que muitas pessoas excelentes, principalmente de grupos sub-representados, hesitam em se candidatar quando não atendem a 100% dos requisitos. Se esta oportunidade te interessa, queremos te conhecer mesmo assim.
DICA IMPORTANTE: a comunicação durante o processo seletivo é feita por e-mail. Sugerimos que você fique de olho na sua caixa de entrada e libere o recebimento de mensagens de @cheesecakelabs.hire.trakstar.com, para que nossas mensagens não caiam no spam ;)
## Como usamos IA aqui
Na Cheesecake Labs, agentes de IA fazem a maior parte da execução: código, infraestrutura, modelos de dados, pesquisa, protótipos e documentação. As pessoas tomam as decisões: o que será construído e em que ordem, a arquitetura, a alocação dos times e qualquer assunto que envolva pessoas. Todas as vagas aqui especificam, direcionam a IA, verificam o resultado e respondem pelo que é entregue.
Em todos os projetos, também seguimos algumas regras:
• Usar apenas ferramentas aprovadas, por meio das contas corporativas da Cheesecake Labs.
• Seguir as regras de cada cliente sobre IA. Alguns clientes exigem uma stack de IA específica, e mercados altamente regulados (como o setor bancário no Brasil) podem exigir modelos hospedados no país.
• Nunca inserir dados de clientes ou dados pessoais (nomes, datas de nascimento, e-mails) em uma LLM sem antes anonimizá-los. O mesmo vale para os dados das nossas próprias pessoas.
• Cumprir a LGPD e as demais leis de proteção de dados aplicáveis.
Os dados pessoais coletados serão usados apenas para gerenciar e controlar os currículos das pessoas candidatas, a fim de avaliar os requisitos necessários, como as informações de contato, e também para conduzir este processo seletivo.
Os dados coletados não serão compartilhados com terceiros sem a sua autorização, e seu uso será restrito à equipe interna da Cheesecake Labs e aos prestadores de serviço que processam seus dados para o processo seletivo. A qualquer momento, você pode entrar em contato conosco e removeremos seus dados do nosso sistema de coleta de dados. Para isso, basta enviar um e-mail para .

title: Technical Consultant - Cloud Security
description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.
Technical Consultants are experienced experts in information security and/or information security governance or compliance. Successful candidates support the Security and Compliance Practice in Delivery, Business Development, and Practice Development.
Technical Consultants collaborate with a diverse team of consultants with varying skills to meet and exceed client expectations through scoped engagements. They effectively support client engagements onsite or remotely by guiding engagements toward scoped objectives and troubleshooting to effectively resolve project risks or issues. Sr. Consultants contribute to engagements by executing the necessary project tasks, producing expected collateral, and presentingartifacts at any time throughout an engagement.
Technical Consultants can also support business development activities alongside a sales specialist to help qualify client needs and expectations, or more specifically to demonstrate a capability or skillset. They may be directly engaged in client-facing interactions to identify client needs and to produce and/or present sales proposals.
Lastly, AHEAD Technical Consultants also leverage their visibility and experience to contribute to the continuous improvement and maturation of in-practice service offerings and capabilities by proposing ideas for change and executing on ideas that are committed. This includes positively impacting our service portfolio and individuals on the team through thought leadership and mentorship.
## Responsibilities
## Client Delivery
Facilitate sessions of strategy, roadmap, design, and planning workshops for medium to large service engagements
Ensure that customer expectations are appropriately set and managed
Lead project engagement teams through the delivery of consulting service offerings
Drive and manage the objectives, requirements gathering, project tasks/milestone, project status, dependencies, and timelines, to ensure engagements are delivered successfully and on time while meeting the business objectives
Breaks down risks or issues into manageable segments, identifies the factors that affect a problem and determine how best to approach
Creation and finalization of project deliverables, may perform peer review for collateral developed by others on a delivery team
Presentation of deliverables to client executive management
Knowledge of AHEAD’s project lifecycle management activities to effectively support delivery engagements throughout the duration of a project
Act as the Engagement Lead on customer facing projects, when assigned
## Business Development
Support business development pursuits through client discovery meetings
Represent service offerings during the sales cycle, including project scoping, proposal development, and presenting proposals to clients
Knowledge of AHEAD’s sales management lifecycle to effectively support sales opportunities throughout the duration of a proposal
Assist Principal Consultants with engagement scoping and the creation of proposal collateral
Familiarity with AHEAD’s enterprise service portfolio to identify opportunities for cross-practice collaboration
Practice Development & Thought Leadership
Maintain subject matter expertise in a minimum of eight security domains or three security solutions
Participate in the development, enhancement, and standardization of AHEAD in-practice service offerings
Owns and/or enables more than one service capability
Process-focused technology thought leader and evangelist
Maintain a broad knowledge and understanding of current and future state IT trends, technologies, and standards
## Lend support and mentorship to others
## Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
Cloud Security Architecture & Risk Strategy:
Proven experience in reviewing and implementing secure cloud reference architectures and landing zones.
Ability to translate risk strategy by mapping traditional lift-and-shift approaches into cloud-native security controls.
Strong understanding of multi-cloud governance models including Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), policy-as-code (PaC), tagging standards, and multi-account strategies.
## CNAPP Tooling:
5+ years of hands-on experience with CNAPP tools, particularly Wiz and Prisma Cloud.
Expertise in integrating Wiz and Prisma Cloud with enterprise tooling such as ServiceNow, CI/CD pipelines, and ticketing/alerting workflows.
Able to clearly and concisely communicate Wiz/Prisma outputs (criticality, risk, remediation) to technical and business stakeholders.
Strong track record in deploying and instantiating Prisma Cloud.
Cloud Platforms & Native Security Controls:
5+ years of experience working with AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
Familiarity with cloud-native security services such as AWS Security Hub, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and Google Security Command Center.
Hands-on knowledge of cloud identity (IAM, Federation, RBAC) across multi-cloud environments.
Familiarity with IDaaS solutions such as Okta and Entra ID.
## Security Frameworks & Governance:
Strong knowledge of security standards and frameworks: CIS Benchmarks, NIST, FedRAMP, ISO 27001, GDPR.
Ability to design and map cloud-specific controls for audit and compliance needs.
Experience with SIEM integration (Splunk, Sentinel, Chronicle) and cloud-native detection capabilities.
## Automation, IaC & Container Security:
Ability to read, understand, and apply Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation).
Familiarity with policy-as-code tooling (OPA, Sentinel) and IaC scanning in CI/CD pipelines.
Proficiency in scripting (Python, PowerShell, Bash) to automate security tasks.
Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and securing workloads at scale.

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.
We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

title: Applied AI Engineer, Applied AI
description:
About Snowplow
Snowplow is the real-time customer context layer that collects, validates, enriches, and delivers behavioral data for advanced analytics, ML, and AI agent decisioning. Snowplow's event tracking is leveraged across 2M+ websites and applications globally, processing over one trillion events per month.
More than 250 companies, including Experian, AutoTrader, Strava, Condé Nast, and HelloFresh, rely on Snowplow to build a well-governed, first-party data foundation that powers their customer-facing AI agents, in-session personalization and recommendations, and real-time analytics.
This Opportunity
Snowplow is rebuilding how the company runs its own work, and the Applied AI team owns Firn, the data and AI platform that work runs on, and the engineering standards that go with it. This role is an Applied AI engineer embedded with one business team, the way a site reliability engineer sits inside a product team: your line manager, your code reviewers and your career path come from Applied AI; your backlog and your day come from the team you serve. The Senior Director you report to still ships code.
Your team is Growth, the group inside Marketing that books new meetings for our sellers. Its workflows already produce pipeline: an always-on outbound engine that scores accounts daily and sends hundreds of personalized sequences, a campaign builder that turns an AE's target list into a reviewed campaign, a morning routine that ranks warm contacts by intent signal, enrichment and signal pipelines from Apollo, Vector, Kettlepoint and reo.dev into Snowflake, and a paid-media loop that adjusts ads. They were built by people close to the work to get results fast, and they did. Now they need an engineer who makes them production grade and keeps them improving.
You take over that estate, make it reliable, and make it better every week. The Director of Growth sets what matters, which is what moves pipeline now. You decide how it gets built and you build it. You work with our data engineers on scoring models and the semantic layer, with the platform engineer on the framework your workflows move onto, and with the Growth Associates and AEs who use what you ship. The engineering standards are Applied AI's; the tempo is Growth's.
What you will own
• The GTM workflows in production. The outbound orchestrator and its sequences, the campaign builder, the intent-signal routine, the enrichment and signal pipelines, and the paid-media loop. You know how each one runs, what it costs, and what to do when it breaks.
• Review steps before anything sends. Agents that check the list, confirm each signal is current, and review the copy before a sequence goes out, with a holdback gate and sampled human sign-off on anything headed for an inbox we have not already had a reply from.
• The learning loop. Replies and meetings booked feed back into who we contact and what we say. You instrument the sends, run A/B tests on variants, and show the Growth team which messaging is working.
• Signals and enrichment. The pipelines that bring third-party signals and first-party behavior into Snowflake: Kettlepoint job-change and hiring signals, Apollo firmographics, and our own event data. You also own the fields the Growth team needs exposed through our MCP tools, and the work with our data engineers that gets them there.
• Skills and routines for sellers. The Claude skills the Growth Associates and AEs run each morning, the campaign tooling, and the short working sessions that get a new team using them.
• Deliverability and suppression. One set of contact rules every sender reads, warm-inbox discipline, and the suppression windows that keep us welcome in people's inboxes.
• Engineering standards on your estate. Version control, alerting, tracing, runbooks and documented handover for every workflow you run, and a steady move of those workflows onto the Firn factory framework.
• The weekly cadence. A standing backlog with the Director of Growth, priorities set by pipeline, and a short written account of what shipped and what it did. When a priority and an engineering standard conflict, the Director of Growth and the Senior Director of Applied AI settle it together.
We would love to hear from you if you have
• Written software that runs in production. Python and SQL are your working languages, you use git every day, and when you meet a new API you read the docs and use it. Tools like n8n, Clay or Zapier are in your kit, and when they run out you write the code.
• Built with LLMs for real work. Prompts, tools, structured outputs and evaluation, and the failure modes of each. You know what a model does when a prompt does not say where to get its data, and you design against it.
• Run something that could not go down. Alerting, error handling, retries and recovery are habits, and when something does fail you fix the class of problem, not the instance.
• Moved data into a warehouse. You have built or maintained pipelines into Snowflake or an equivalent, and you can model a table in dbt or learn to quickly.
• Sat with sellers and marketers. You can take a growth director's ask, work out what they need, and come back with something they use the next week. When an ask is a symptom of a broken process, you say so before you build it.
• A fast tempo. The team you serve measures in meetings booked per week. You are measured on what you build: whether it runs, what it costs, and what it changed for the team. You ship small, measure, and say plainly when something is not working.
• An AI-native way of working you can show us. A workflow, automation or agent you built and still use. Expect to demonstrate it during the interview process.
• Comfort being embedded. You can sit inside another team, take its priorities, and still hold the engineering standards your own team sets.
Bonus points for
• Experience with Salesforce, Apollo, Smartlead, Lemlist or similar GTM tooling and their APIs.
• Experience with email deliverability at volume.
• Experience with paid-media platform APIs.
How we hire for this role
The interview process includes a short technical exercise in code and a working session where you walk us through how you work with AI on a real task, using your own setup. We work this way ourselves, and you are welcome to use AI when applying.
What you get in return for being awesome
• Meaningful equity stake
• Competitive Base Salary
• Flexible working
• Generous PTO
• Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
• 401k
• MacBook and home office equipment allowance
• Enhanced Family leave

title: AI Strategist
description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.
Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.
Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.
## About the Role:
As an AI Strategist, you are the embedded AI leader for our customers. You connect what customers are saying in their conversations, what their business needs most, and what Cresta's AI can do, then turn that into a prioritized plan and measurable results. You identify where automation and augmentation will deliver the most value, build the roadmap, and make sure the work ships and pays off.
You will not be building AI Agents from scratch. Our Forward Deployed Engineers and Forward Deployed Product Managers create and deploy them. Your focus is on making deployed AI better: finding the next opportunity, optimizing what is already live, piloting new Cresta capabilities, and proving the business impact. You are analytical, commercially minded, and credible with senior stakeholders in CX, Operations, Product, Sales, and IT. You are technical enough to work closely with FDEs and FDPMs and to give product and engineering a tight feedback loop.
## What You'll Do:
## AI Strategy and Roadmap
• Identify automation and augmentation opportunities across the customer's contact center and wider customer experience operation.
• Prioritize initiatives by expected ROI and build a business case for each one.
• Build and maintain the customer's enterprise AI roadmap, and keep it current as priorities and Cresta capabilities change.
• Align stakeholders across CX, Operations, Product, Sales, and IT on priorities, sequencing, and success criteria.
## Conversation Intelligence and Business Insights
• Use conversation data to surface customer friction and emerging trends before they show up in other metrics.
• Identify operational inefficiencies and the changes that would reduce them.
• Share Voice of Customer insights with customer leadership and with Cresta product teams.
• Measure business impact and report it in terms executives care about, such as containment, handle time, conversion, CSAT, and cost to serve.
## AI Innovation and Execution
• Stay current on new Cresta features and bring the relevant ones to customers early.
• Pilot emerging AI capabilities, define how success will be judged, and decide with the customer whether to scale them.
• Optimize live AI Agents by analyzing performance, reviewing conversations, and recommending changes to prompts, workflows, and configurations.
• Coordinate deployments with FDEs, FDPMs, and customer teams, including milestones, timelines, and dependencies.
• Measure realized value after launch and report it back against the original business case.
## What We're Looking For:
• Experience: 5+ years in technology consulting, strategy, product, analytics, implementation, or customer success roles, ideally with AI or LLM-first products.
• Strategic and commercial skills: A track record of building roadmaps, prioritizing by ROI, and writing business cases that senior stakeholders approve.
• Analytical approach: Strong data skills. You are comfortable analyzing conversation or operational data, designing experiments such as A/B tests, and monitoring performance to refine solutions.
• Technical understanding: Working knowledge of how LLM-based AI agents function, including prompts, tools or function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation. Hands-on experience with an agent project, even a personal one, is a plus. You do not need to write production code, but you can read and reason about system behavior and discuss tradeoffs with engineers.
• Stakeholder leadership: Experience leading cross-functional work and influencing senior customer stakeholders across CX, Operations, Product, Sales, and IT.
• Communication: Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills. You can explain a complex finding to an executive in plain language.
• Execution: Strong project management skills and a bias for action. You turn ambiguity into a plan and follow it through to results.
• Mindset: Curious, self-driven, and comfortable learning quickly in a fast-moving startup environment. You are passionate about AI, automation, and the future of customer experience.
• Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
## Bonus Points:
• Familiarity with customer support and contact center operations, including metrics such as AHT, FCR, containment, and QA
• Experience with conversation intelligence, speech analytics, or voice-of-customer programs
• Background in management consulting, product management, or forward deployed roles
• Experience in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment
• Comfort with SQL or a BI tool for self-serve analysis
## Perks & Benefits:
We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:
• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family
• Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it
• Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child
• Retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future
• Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office
• Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced
• In-office meal program and commuter benefits provided for onsite employees
## Compensation at Cresta:
Cresta's approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.
The posted compensation range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.
OTE Range: $150,000 to $200,000 + Offers Equity

Recruiting impersonation scams: We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored.

title: Applied Scientist, Pro Growth
description:
## Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.
Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.
## About the Applied Science Team
We’re looking for applied scientists with deep expertise in machine learning, optimization, building data products, and/or statistical models. As part of a small product team you will have full ownership over your domain, so you should be a person who dreams big, then executes well.
At Thumbtack, the Applied Science team is responsible for a wide variety of problems spanning AI, machine learning, statistics, and computer science:
Improve customer and service provider matching. Matching and optimization algorithms are fundamental to Thumbtack’s product: we now service millions of matches per week. Identifying better matches between customers and service providers has an incredible impact on the experience of customers and professionals transacting on our platform.
Model complex relationships in the presence of many confounding factors. Predictive modeling problems are everywhere across our product. Our team works to scope, design and implement machine learning models to support Thumbtack’s product and marketing.
Characterize marketplace dynamics. Thumbtack’s marketplaces consist of thousands of active markets across our service categories and U.S. cities. Via exploratory data analysis and experimental design, our team works to understand trends and behaviors within these markets.
Build AI features. Use state-of-the-art approaches such as large language models (LLMs), reinforcement learning and agentic workflows to enhance customer / pro experience, increase acquisition and marketplace efficiency, and to automate and enhance internal processes.
Build a healthy marketplace. We evolve and manage the monetization mechanics of our marketplace, including defining the parameters that affect the prices we charge.
## The challenge
Thumbtack constantly works to balance supply and demand across thousands of local markets and hundreds of service categories. The Pro Growth pod is responsible for the science behind acquiring and activating the right pros, at the right time, in the right markets, to keep the marketplace healthy and growing. As an Applied Scientist on Pro Growth, you’ll build models and experiments that shape who joins Thumbtack, how they get activated, how we forecast supply needs by market and trade, and how we accelerate time-to-value for new pros. We leverage machine learning, causal inference, and optimization to strategically grow and shape our pro supply base. Our work directly contributes to meeting demand projections, unlocking strategic partnerships, and ultimately enhancing customer experience and platform growth by ensuring a robust and high-quality supply of pros.
You’ll work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers, product managers, and other applied scientists on a portfolio that ranges from incrementality and market forecasting to LLM-powered onboarding agents. You’ll own end-to-end: from problem framing, through experiment design, through deploying models to production, through measuring business impact.
## What you’ll do
Initiate and drive applied science projects to completion, with a focus on the business impact of those projects on pro acquisition, activation, retention, and supply health.
Develop, deploy, and optimize machine learning models for supply-side problems, including: lead scoring and pro acquisition targeting, market-level supply forecasting, pro onboarding and activation, retention and churn prediction, and agentic onboarding workflows.
Design and execute well-powered marketplace experiments to measure model and product impact on supply and business metrics.
Analyze structured and unstructured data such as marketplace interactions, pro profiles, external supply signals, to identify trends, opportunities, and risks related to supply health.
Collaborate closely with engineering, product management, business development, and marketing teams to define problems, develop end-to-end solutions, and ensure successful implementation and monitoring of ML systems in production.
Maintain the right balance between speed of execution and scientific rigor when designing solutions for a fast-paced marketplace environment.
Contribute to evolving the team’s agentic-first ways of working, including LLM-powered tooling, eval coverage, and the use of AI agents in day-to-day applied science.
## In order to be successful, you must bring
Master’s degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, or related), or equivalent industry experience.
3+ years of industry experience as an applied scientist, data scientist, or ML engineer with ownership of production ML models.
Experience in applied science within a marketplace, supply chain, or growth domain.
Solid knowledge of machine learning techniques such as classification, regression, embedding-based approaches, and causal inference.
Familiarity with modern LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, AWS Bedrock) and experience with agentic AI development practices and tools.
Good knowledge of probability, statistics, and econometric methods, including experimental design, causal inference, and optimization.
Experience with large-scale distributed systems (Spark, Databricks, or similar).
Ability to effectively read, write, and debug code in programming languages such as Python and SQL.
Ability to break down complex problems rigorously and understand the tradeoffs necessary to deliver impactful projects.
Ability to communicate clearly and effectively to cross-functional partners of various technical levels.
Demonstrated ability to drive seamless execution end-to-end on at least one production ML project.

Actual offered salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as calibrated job level, qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

title: Anthropic Fellows Program, ML Systems & Reinforcement Learning
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Anthropic Fellows Program overview

The Anthropic Fellows Program is designed to foster AI research and engineering talent. We provide funding and mentorship to promising technical talent - regardless of previous experience.

Fellows will primarily use external infrastructure (e.g. open-source models, public APIs) to work on an empirical project aligned with our research priorities, with the goal of producing a public output (e.g. a paper submission). In one of our earlier cohorts, over 80% of fellows produced papers. We run multiple cohorts of Fellows each year and review applications on a rolling basis.

Apply at the bottom of this page. We are accepting applications on a rolling basis for the next cohort expected to start in January 2027. In some circumstances, we can accommodate fellows starting outside the usual cohort timelines — please note in your application if the January 2027 start date doesn't work for you.

What to expect

  • 4 months of full-time research 
  • Direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers 
  • Access to a shared workspace 
  • Connection to the broader AI safety and security research community
  • Weekly stipend of 4,615 USD / 3,440 GBP / 6,470 CAD / 4,110 EUR + benefits (these vary by country)
  • Funding for compute (~$15k/month) and other research expenses

Interview process

The interview process will include an initial application, assessments, and interviews. We may ask for references later in the process as well.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Compensation

The expected base stipend for this role is 4,615 USD / 3,440 GBP / 6,470 CAD / 4,110 EUR per week, with an expectation of 40 hours per week for 4 months (with possible extension).

ML Systems & Performance Fellows

Mentors, research areas, & past projects

Fellows will undergo a project selection & mentor matching process. Potential mentors include:

  • Alwin Peng
  • Zygi Straznickas

Note: You may research mentors' prior work, but all applications must go through the official form, not the mentors.

For a past example of an engineering-heavy project, see:

  • AI agents find $4.6M in blockchain smart contract exploits

Projects in this workstream may include:

  • Building a CPU simulator for accelerator workloads
  • Adding backends for different accelerators on an open source project
  • Building on demand infrastructure for other infrastructure heavy fellows projects 
  • Building complex synthetic data or environment pipelines

Unique candidate criteria

You might be a particularly great fit for this workstream if you:

  • Have strong software engineering skills with experience building complex ML systems
  • Can balance research exploration with engineering rigor and operational reliability
  • Enjoy collaborating across research and engineering disciplines
  • Are comfortable working with large-scale distributed systems and high-performance computing (e.g. in trading)
  • Have experience with training, fine-tuning, or evaluating large language models
  • Are adept at analyzing and debugging model training processes

You may be a good fit if you

  • Are motivated by making sure AI is safe and beneficial for society as a whole
  • Are excited to transition into empirical AI research and would be interested in a full-time role at Anthropic
  • Have a strong technical background in computer science, mathematics, or physics
  • Thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments
  • Can implement ideas quickly and communicate clearly

Candidates must be

  • Fluent in Python programming
  • Available to work full-time on the Fellows program

Reinforcement Learning Fellows

Mentors, research areas, & past projects

Fellows will undergo a project selection & mentor matching process. Potential research areas and mentors include:

  • Ruhua Jiang
  • Kaidi Cao
  • Sunny Duan
  • David Brandfonbrener
  • Colt Steele
  • Dino Distefano
  • Will Williams

Projects in this workstream may include:

  • Building model-based tools to better understand AI training data and improve training data quality
  • A research project to better understand generalization
  • Creating RL environments to improve Claude models at capabilities that are within your domain of expertise
  • Building RL environments for safety-related tasks
  • Conducting research and implementing solutions in areas such as RL algorithms

Unique candidate criteria

You might be a particularly great fit for this workstream if you:

  • Have strong software engineering skills with experience building complex ML systems
  • Can balance research exploration with engineering rigor and operational reliability
  • Enjoy collaborating across research and engineering disciplines
  • Are comfortable working with large-scale distributed systems and high-performance computing
  • Have experience with training, fine-tuning, or evaluating large language models
  • Are adept at analyzing and debugging model training processes

Logistics

Logistics Requirements: To participate in the Fellows program, you must have work authorization in the US, UK, or Canada and be located in that country during the program.

Workspace Locations: We have designated shared workspaces in SF. We are also open to remote fellows in the UK, US, or Canada. 

Visa Sponsorship: We are not currently able to sponsor visas for fellows. To participate in the Fellows program, you need to have or independently obtain full-time work authorization in the UK, the US, or Canada.

Program Duration: The program runs for 4 months, full-time. If you can't commit to the full duration, please still apply and note your constraints in the application. We review these requests on a case-by-case basis.

Please note: We do not guarantee that we will make any full-time offers to fellows. However, strong performance during the program may indicate that a Fellow would be a good fit for full-time roles at Anthropic. In previous cohorts, 25-50% of fellows received a full-time offer, and we’ve supported many more to go on to do great work on AI safety and security at other organizations.

The below are Anthropic's policies for full time roles. These do NOT apply to the Fellows Program.

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Loft Orbital is looking for an intern to join the End-to-End Validation & Performance (EVP) team and contribute to image-processing and calibration/validation (CAL/VAL) activities for Earth-observation missions. • Implement a baseline estimator: a data-fit term combined with a regularizing prior.
• Investigate additional AI/ML methods only where suitable training or validation data are available; compare them against the baseline rather than assuming they are superior.
• Evaluate correction quality, residual fixed-pattern structure, stability across images, runtime, and failure cases.

• Present findings and recommendations to EVP and CAL/VAL stakeholders; document what evidence would be needed before operational use.

• Radiometric calibration and CAL/VAL for space-based optical imaging.

• Experimental design, reference-data limitations, and quantitative performance assessment.
• Building reproducible engineering tools and communicating technical evidence to mission teams.
