title: AI/ML Engineering Intern: System 1 Models for Reactive Space Operations
description:
Wanna join the adventure?
Loft Orbital flies other people's payloads on standardized satellites, giving our customers a fast, simple, and reliable path to orbit. Our AI for Space team is looking for a motivated intern to explore how fast, lightweight “System 1” models can boost reactivity, performance, and usability across our satellite operational chains.
Reactivity use cases are at the heart of Loft's vision, and we are scaling them: from single-satellite reactive loops, to two-satellite / two-sensor tip & cue (a detection from one sensor automatically cueing an acquisition by another), and ultimately multi-satellite scenarios. Today we mostly rely on “System 2” models — powerful but slow and heavy at inference — from our partners. “System 1” models (fast, intuitive) are coming back strongly and could add value not only on reactivity, but also on performance and ease of use. This internship will assess that added value and prototype it on our reactivity scenarios.
Location: Toulouse office, city center (Jeanne d’Arc metro station)
Duration: 6-month, end-of-studies internship — target start date: early 2027.
About this role:
• Review the state of the art on System 1 / fast, intuitive models and compare them with the System 2 models used today, including our partners' models.
• Map where System 1 models could bring value in our operational chain for reactivity use cases, from detection to tasking.
• Define benchmark scenarios of increasing complexity with the team: a single-satellite reactive loop, then a two-satellite / two-sensor tip & cue loop, and, as a stretch goal, a multi-satellite scenario.
• Set the latency budget, accuracy needs, and execution context for each scenario.
• Build datasets and evaluation sets from Loft data, partner outputs, and open datasets.
• Train or fine-tune System 1 models and benchmark them against System 2 baselines on reactivity (latency), performance (accuracy, compute footprint), and ease of use (integration and operational effort).
• Prototype an end-to-end reactive loop, possibly as a hybrid design where System 1 triggers and System 2 validates, and assess how it extends to multi-satellite coordination.
• Document results and recommendations for production use, and deliver a final demo.
Must Haves:
• Final-year engineering or Master's student specialized in ML / deep learning / computer vision.
• Solid Python and PyTorch skills, and good software engineering practices.
• Strong understanding of the state of the art in LLM / VLM / Reinforcement Learning.
• Practical experience training neural networks (language models or computer vision) and/or LLM manipulation.
Nice to Haves:
• Model optimization (quantization, distillation, edge inference).
• Exposure to satellite or geospatial data.
• Multi-agent or distributed systems experience.
• Genuine interest in space.
What Can We Offer?
You will join the AI for Space team and directly support the scaling of reactivity use cases, a core part of Loft's vision — working toward shorter detection-to-tasking latency on single-satellite and tip & cue scenarios, and a first step towards multi-satellite reactive operations. You'll build new expertise on an emerging class of models, reusable across other detection-like use cases, with a concrete prototype and benchmark the team can build on. Mercari Engineering Principles are a shared understanding that serves as the foundation of engineering beliefs and behavior at Mercari. The Platform team helps Mercari engineers deliver more reliable services and improve development efficiency by managing the entire network — from edge areas such as the CDN to the cloud, service mesh (Istio), and physical data centers. As Mercari invests in self-hosted compute for its AI/LLM initiatives, we are building a new on-premises GPU infrastructure capability within the team. This role owns the on-prem side: securing data-center facilities and building the network foundation that enables GPU compute, and integrating it securely with our existing cloud and platform networks. We are primarily looking for a data-center (DC) network engineer — ideally with hands-on GPU installation and maintenance experience — who will also collaborate closely with our Corporate IT team on facilities, connectivity, and on-site operations.
## Work Responsibilities
• Design, build, and operate Mercari's on-prem DC/GPU infrastructure, including data-center facilities (racks, power, cooling) and the supporting network
• Design and build the network foundation for GPU workloads: compute fabric (InfiniBand/RoCE), storage/in-band, service network, and isolated OOB management
• Design, configure, and operate routing for the on-prem GPU fabric and its cloud/platform interconnects using BGP (and OSPF/IS-IS, VLAN/VRF as needed), including ASN planning, route summarization, and routing policy
• Coordinate with data-center providers and SI partners on facility readiness, equipment procurement, lead times, and remote-hands/installation work
• Manage Mercari's internal data center end to end, including vendor/SI discussions, commercial negotiations, and contract & procurement handling
• Perform hands-on, on-site data-center networking work — running and changing cabling, and configuring routers, switches, firewalls, and other network devices (this role requires regular physical visits to our data center)
• Integrate the on-prem DC/GPU environment securely with existing corporate, cloud (GCP/AWS), and platform networks
• Establish monitoring, alerting, logging, and operational handoff for GPU systems and network devices
• Support GPU PoC execution and help define the path from PoC to production
• Automate provisioning and operations, and manage configuration as code (IaC)
• Collaborate closely with the Corporate IT team on data-center facilities, connectivity, and on-site operations (this collaboration is required for the role)
• Collaborate with ML Platform, Infrastructure, Security, and Procurement stakeholders
• Own data-center facility readiness (rack, power, cooling, carry-in routes), including NVIDIA pre-delivery site survey confirmation for DGX B200/B300-class nodes
• Drive RFP, quotation, and vendor selection cycles with partners, and own NDA, R&R/RACI, contract, and PO handling together with Procurement
• Prepare technical and cost materials for internal approval gates (JB Engineering board, investment committee, Procurement Team), including TCO/ROI comparison against cloud GPU/TPU
• Build and operate storage and dataset paths for models and checkpoints, and keep the stack portable between on-prem and GCP/GKE so workloads can fall back to cloud
• Define and operate SLOs, on-call, incident response, runbooks, and BCP/DR for the on-prem inference environment, aligned with Mercari SRE practices

title: AI Research Intern – Time Series Foundation Models
description:
We are looking for research interns interested in advancing foundation models for multimodal and sensor-rich environments. Our research explores how AI systems can learn generalizable representations from heterogeneous real-world data, including time series, audio, vision, and physical sensor signals, and transfer that knowledge across tasks and domains.
As an intern, you will work alongside Bosch researchers on open research problems at the intersection of multimodal learning, foundation models, and real-world sensing. You will have access to challenging datasets and applications from areas such as mobility, manufacturing, robotics, and intelligent systems, with opportunities to turn research ideas into publications and working prototypes.
What You’ll Work On
Your research may explore topics such as:
• Foundation models for time-series and Multimodal data
• Causal Analysis and evidence-based reasoning
• Learning shared representations across images, time series, and other sensing modalities
• Self-supervised learning from large-scale unlabeled sensor datasets
• Multimodal fusion and cross-modal representation learning
• Pre-training strategies for heterogeneous and asynchronous data

title: Full-Stack Engineer
description:
About Onfleet
Onfleet's mission is to power the future of commerce by enabling businesses of all sizes to move goods more efficiently and delightfully. Our product includes intuitive smartphone apps for drivers, a powerful modern web application and dashboard for logistics teams, and automatic notifications and real-time tracking for recipients. Onfleet powers millions of deliveries every week for thousands of businesses around the world across a range of industries, from grocery and prepared meals to pharmacy, flowers, and furniture.
## About the role
Onfleet is hiring a Full-Stack Engineer based in Latin America or Canada to join one of our cross-functional teams as we build out our Orchestration capabilities. You'll be a core contributor across new feature development, architectural improvements, and system integrations. Your work will span our core platforms, APIs, webhooks, and other integration surfaces, evolving courier and orchestration functionality, and improving internal tooling and developer experience.
The majority of backend work is in Node.js, with a growing Rust codebase in our newer projects. Front-end work is in React, with a mix of JavaScript and TypeScript. You'll work across a blend of greenfield development and continual, thoughtful development and refinement of existing systems: creating high-quality, well-tested code, contributing to a healthy Scrum cadence, and helping tame legacy complexity by putting code under test, isolating change boundaries, and simplifying tangled implementations.
Everyone on the team owns quality. Automated tests are part of our Definition of Done, and nothing goes to production without being well reviewed by humans and AI agents. If you bring deeper testing or automation experience, that is a real advantage in this seat and we will put it to work, but it is not a prerequisite.
If you have strong Computer Science fundamentals, care deeply about quality and craft, and bring a scrutinizing, questioning mindset, we'd love to hear from you.
## How we work
Our engineers combine Computer Science fundamentals with a principled approach to software development that sets a high bar for quality. We're pragmatic, quality-driven, and deliberate about the tools and practices we adopt.
We code using agents, and nearly 100% of our code is written this way. Success here takes a scrutinizing, questioning mindset: the engineers who thrive are the ones who avoid slop, catch the wrong call before it ships, and drive quality and the right engineering choices forward. Generating code is the easy part; knowing what good looks like, and holding the bar, is the job. To be successful in this role you will need enough expertise in the languages we use to challenge both the code an agent writes and the architecture it proposes.
We also expect every engineer to be an active contributor to how we work, not just a consumer of existing workflows. Improving our agentic workflows, orchestration, and tooling is a core part of the role; we're always looking for ways to raise the team's quality and efficiency, and that's expected from everyone. Desire and excitement for the application of AI to software development are critical to this role. We are seeking candidates who want to work in and maintain leading-edge agentic workflows, and stay there as the models and tools evolve.
## What you'll do
• Build and continually improve your own agentic development workflow, and help raise the team's. This goes far beyond prompting for code: we use AI across the whole path, from PRDs to technical specs, epics, and tickets, into development plans, and finally into high-quality code with thorough unit and integration tests.
• Drive quality through disciplined verification and both agentic and human code review, on your own code and your teammates'. Extend our agentic review tooling as you go, and hold the bar on what gets merged.
• Apply your agentic workflow in both greenfield and legacy code, meeting the different challenges each presents.
• Design and implement high-quality, scalable software in parallel with the tests that validate it.
• Drive and show ownership of features end to end: research/planning, design, implementation, validation, deployment and monitoring in production.
• Continuously refactor and simplify code to improve clarity, maintainability, and long-term system health, including making hard-to-reach code testable.
• Develop and refine our APIs, webhooks, and other integration surfaces.
• Work in a healthy Agile/Scrum cadence: reliable estimates, proactive and clear communication, and follow-through on commitments.
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, including participation in the on-call rotation.
• Collaborate with product and cross-functional partners to prioritize features and bug fixes, and lift the people around you through pairing, thorough reviews, and writing things down.
## What you'll bring (required)
A scrutinizing, questioning mindset: you don't accept output, your own or an agent's, at face value, and you surface problems early. You’re open and honest when you see a problem, and seek opportunities to help all of us improve.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience, and strong CS fundamentals: data structures, database fundamentals, API design, testing, and an instinct for clean, maintainable code.
• Front-end and back-end experience, having shipped multiple features that cross the full application stack from ideation to production use by real customers.
• Automated testing experience across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers, including hands-on experience with a browser or end-to-end framework such as Playwright or Selenium.
• 4 or more years of hands-on professional software engineering experience building, shipping, and operating production-quality, reliable systems.
• At least 3 years of professional experience in our core stack: Node.js and React, in TypeScript or JavaScript.
• Experience with creating software using disciplined agentic flows, from prompt-instructing to complete development orchestrations.
• Excellent written and spoken English. You can work entirely in English on a distributed team, explain complex technical ideas clearly, and write docs and code reviews your teammates rely on. This is roughly equivalent to a C1 level of English.

title: AI Agent Mentor CZ
description:
## XPUP
XPUPvznikla z jednoduché potřeby: nemohli jsme najít dostatek profesionálů s odpovídajícími digitálními dovednostmi – tak jsme se rozhodli je vychovat sami.
To, co začalo v roce 2018 jako komunitní iniciativa v Tbilisi, se proměnilo v globální vzdělávací platformu s více než 30 000 absolventy.
Naše programy tvoří experti z praxe, jsou zaměřené na skutečné potřeby trhu a vedené v prostředí spolupráce, zvídavosti a růstu.
V roce 2023 jsme se spojili sTether, abychom naši misi rozšířili do celého světa – zpřístupnit praktické a kariérně posilující vzdělávání všem, kdo chtějí růst.
Dnes budujeme novou generaci digitálních profesionálů: marketérů, designérů, vývojářů a tvůrců, kteří nechtějí jen práci, ale i dopad.
Naše hodnoty jsou jednoduché a žité: lidé na prvním místě, zvědavost, kvalita a zodpovědnost.
## A jsme teprve na začátku.
## Role Overview
Hledáme člověka s praktickými zkušenostmi s AI agenty, který povede náš online kurz AI Agenti. Kurz navazuje na kurz AI Asistenti a automatizace. Účastníci si v něm během 12 lekcí postaví vlastního AI agenta, tedy AI pomocníka, který zvládne celý úkol sám: naplánuje si kroky, pracuje s daty a používá další nástroje.
Účastníci jsou pokročilí uživatelé AI: podnikatelé, manažeři, marketingoví specialisté, lidé z provozu a freelanceři. Většina z nich neprogramuje, kód za ně píše AI. Vaším úkolem je provést je technickou látkou srozumitelně a s klidem.
Budete vést večerní online lekce. Nejde o to naučit účastníky klikat v jednom nástroji, ale pomoct jim pochopit, jak:
poznat, kdy dává smysl agent a kdy stačí jednodušší automatizace,
napojit agenta na vlastní data a nástroje,
## agenta otestovat a hlídat jeho náklady,
## agenta bezpečně spustit do provozu.
## Main Responsibilities
Sdílíte s účastníky své znalosti a zkušenosti s AI agenty.
Připravujete a vedete online lekce, které kombinují výklad, ukázky a praktická cvičení.
Pomáháte účastníkům, když se zaseknou, a provázíte je až k závěrečnému projektu.
Vytváříte přátelskou atmosféru, ve které se účastníci nebojí ptát a sdílet zkušenosti.
Sledujete novinky v AI a průběžně je zapracováváte do kurzu.
## Requirements
Praktickou zkušenost se stavbou AI agentů nebo pokročilých automatizací, které opravdu používáte vy nebo váš tým.
Dobrou orientaci v AI nástrojích (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) a v nástrojích pro automatizace a agenty (například n8n, Make nebo Claude Code).
Základní technické dovednosti: nebojíte se terminálu, API ani jednoduchého skriptu. Programátor být nemusíte.
Přehled o bezpečnosti a ochraně dat při práci s AI.
Kritický pohled na AI: víte, co agenti zvládnou a kde mají limity.
Schopnost srozumitelně vysvětlit technické věci lidem bez technického zázemí.
## Chuť pomáhat druhým a sdílet, co umíte.
Možnost učit na příkladech bez důvěrných dat klientů či zaměstnavatele. Nebrání vám v tom NDA ani konkurenční doložka.
## Češtinu na úrovni C2.
## Nice to have
Zkušenost s výukou, mentoringem nebo vedením workshopů.
## Zkušenost se zaváděním AI ve firmě.
Zkušenost s nasazením agenta na server (například pomocí Dockeru).
Znalost technologií jako RAG, MCP nebo LangGraph.
Vlastní projekty nebo obsah o AI na GitHubu, LinkedInu, blogu nebo YouTube.
## What we offer
Přátelské a inspirativní pracovní prostředí.
Samostatnost a tvůrčí svobodu při vedení kurzů.
Neomezený přístup ke všem kurzům XPUP a slevy pro rodinné příslušníky.
## Atraktivní program odměn za doporučení.
Příležitost pomáhat vychovávat novou generaci lidí, kteří AI rozumějí a umějí ji využívat v praxi.

description:
## Join AORN and Make an Impact
The Association of periOperative Registered Nurses (AORN) is seeking a Clinical Content Developer, Digital Products to help advance patient and staff safety through evidence-based practice, education, and clinical resources that support perioperative nurses. We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and career stages who are excited to bring their expertise to a mission-driven organization.
Bring your perioperative nursing experience and passion for writing together in a role where your clinical knowledge can make an impact beyond the operating room. As part of the AORN Publications team, you will research, write, edit, and develop practical digital content for eGuidelines+, helping perioperative professionals translate evidence-based guidance into everyday practice.
Location: Remote
Headquarters: Denver, CO
## Why You'll Love This Role
• Make a meaningful impact on patient and staff safety.
• Work remotely with a collaborative and supportive team.
• Contribute ideas that help shape the future of perioperative nursing.
• Join a culture that values innovation, inclusion, and professional growth.
## Why Join AORN?
At AORN, you'll find purpose-driven work, an engaging remote culture, and a team dedicated to advancing perioperative nursing.
## Our values guide everything we do:
Integrity:Ethical, Credible and Transparent
Excellence:Achievement, Quality and Data-Driven
Accountability:Ownership, Timeliness and Responsibility
Collaboration:Partnership, Communication and Teamwork
Inclusion:Belonging, Respect and Fairness
Whether you're early in your career or bringing years of expertise, you'll have the opportunity to contribute and make a difference.
## What You’ll Do
The Clinical Content Developer, Digital Products is a perioperative registered nurse and member of the AORN Publications team who transforms complex clinical and evidence-based information into clear, practical, and engaging digital content for perioperative professionals. Working closely with the Managing Editor of Digital Products and clinical subject matter experts, this position researches, writes, edits, and maintains content for AORN’s eGuidelines+ (eG+) platform, including text, images, video and animation, and workflow tools.
Drawing on firsthand knowledge of perioperative practice and clinical workflows, the Clinical Content Developer creates quick-reference resources that meet the needs of professionals working in surgical and invasive procedure settings. The position ensures content is accurate, accessible, and consistent with the AORN Guidelines for Perioperative Practice and other evidence-based practices that support safe patient care and positive patient outcomes.
The Clinical Content Developer collaborates across AORN and with clinical subject matter experts to identify customer and clinician needs, incorporate voice-of-the-customer feedback, and continually improve the relevance and usefulness of eG+ content. The position contributes to product goals by delivering timely, relevant, high-quality clinical content that meets customer needs and serves as a backup to the Managing Editor for designated eG+ platform activities and support.
## JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

title: AI Solutions Architect
description:
About QuilrAI
QuilrAI is an agent-native security company founded by security veterans to secure and operationalize the agentic enterprise across the entire agent lifecycle. We treat AI as a deployment problem—ensuring agents are assessed, governed by policy, and deployed via approved blueprints before they reach production, with every agent action decided before execution and verified afterward.
Headquartered in Austin, Texas, we partner with high-growth tech firms and enterprise customers across financial services, legal, and business operations to protect critical workflows against prompt injection, data exfiltration, and non-deterministic model behavior.
## The Role
As an AI Solutions Architect, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to enterprise customers, helping them design and implement secure, scalable AI solutions using Quilr. You will work closely with customer architects, engineering leaders, platform teams, and security stakeholders to understand their environments, translate business and security requirements into practical architectures, and guide technical evaluations and deployments. Internally, you will partner with Solutions Engineering, Field Development, Sales, Product, and Core Engineering to ensure that proposed solutions are technically sound, secure, and achievable.
This is a customer-facing, hands-on architecture role for someone who can connect enterprise AI strategy with implementation details and explain technical trade-offs clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
## What You Will Do
## Customer Discovery and Solution Design
• Lead technical discovery sessions with customer engineering, cloud, platform, and security teams to understand their AI use cases, infrastructure, constraints, and risk requirements.
• Design end-to-end solutions that integrate Quilr with enterprise LLM applications, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, data sources, APIs, and MCP-based workflows.
• Translate customer needs into solution architectures, integration patterns, deployment plans, and technical success criteria.
• Create architecture diagrams, technical proposals, implementation roadmaps, and solution documentation tailored to each customer environment.
• Build technical champions, meet face to face with prospects and develop trusted relationships with our prospects and customers.
## Enterprise AI Security Architecture
• Assess AI application architectures and identify security risks involving prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, unsafe tool execution, excessive agent permissions, and untrusted context.
• Design appropriate trust boundaries, authentication and authorization patterns, policy enforcement points, secrets-management practices, and audit logging.
• Recommend secure deployment patterns across cloud, private cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments, based on customer requirements and product capabilities.
• Consider reliability, scalability, performance, observability, maintainability, and operational readiness as part of each proposed solution.
## Technical Evaluations and Deployment Guidance
• Support presales activities, technical workshops, architecture reviews, proof-of-concept (POC) planning, and customer technical evaluations.
• Define measurable POC success criteria and help customers validate functionality, security controls, integration feasibility, and operational fit.
• Guide AI Field Developers and Solutions Engineers through implementation decisions, integration dependencies, and complex technical escalations.
• Collaborate with customer teams to resolve architectural blockers and support a smooth transition from evaluation to production deployment.
## Cross-Functional Product Collaboration
• Partner with Sales, Product, and Engineering to align customer requirements with Quilr's capabilities and roadmap.
• Capture recurring customer needs, architectural gaps, and field insights, and translate them into actionable product feedback.
• Develop reusable reference architectures, implementation patterns, and best practices that improve consistency across customer deployments.
• Communicate technical trade-offs, limitations, risks, and dependencies clearly without overpromising product capabilities.
## Required Qualifications
• Typically 5+ years of experience in solutions architecture, software engineering, cloud architecture, cybersecurity, platform engineering, or a related technical field.
• Demonstrated experience designing and integrating enterprise applications, APIs, cloud services, or distributed systems.
• Working knowledge of LLM-powered applications, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and modern AI application architectures.
• Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, identity and access management, authentication, authorization, and enterprise integration patterns.
• Ability to design secure, scalable, reliable solutions and explain technical trade-offs to engineering teams and business stakeholders.
• Experience in customer-facing technical consulting, architecture workshops, presales engineering, or technical solution delivery.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create architecture diagrams, technical proposals, and implementation plans.
• Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving requirements and product capabilities.
## Nice to Have
• Experience in AI security, application security, cloud security, or product security.
• Familiarity with OWASP guidance for LLM applications and agentic AI, threat modeling, AI red-teaming, or penetration-testing methodologies.
• Knowledge of MCP clients, servers, tools, permissions, and trust boundaries.
• Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, plus Docker, Kubernetes, API gateways, or service meshes.
• Familiarity with SIEM platforms, secrets management, enterprise identity providers, and security monitoring.
• Experience defining security controls, AI risk-management practices, or governance requirements for enterprise AI deployments.
• Relevant cloud, security, or architecture certifications.
## What Success Looks Like
• Deliver clear, secure, and implementable solution architectures that meet customer requirements.
• Help customers validate technical fit and move efficiently from discovery and evaluation to deployment.
• Build credibility and trust with customer engineering, architecture, and security stakeholders.
• Reduce repeated implementation effort through reusable reference architectures and integration patterns.
• Provide actionable field feedback that informs Quilr's product capabilities and roadmap.
## Important Logistical Note
Candidates must possess active, valid US work authorization. Quilr is currently unable to provide visa sponsorship.

description:
## About Us:
Nivoda: Where Innovation and Gemstones Meet 💎
At Nivoda, we’re reimagining how the world buys and sells jewellery. Our global marketplace connects retailers and suppliers across diamonds, gemstones, and finished jewellery - already powering over $300M in annual transactions and scaling fast toward our billion-dollar vision.
We’re bringing tech, data, and automation to a $350B industry that’s barely scratched the surface of digital transformation. The result? Explosive growth and massive opportunity powered by a team that makes it happen.
## Our Mission
The idea of Nivoda was inspired by the ongoing inefficiency of diamond trading. We set out to develop the solution to help businesses, regardless of their size or location, increase their sales and margins, whilst removing the operational burden of sourcing diamonds.
## The Engineering & RevOps Team
Our Engineering and RevOps teams sit at the heart of everything Nivoda builds. We move fast, take ownership, and obsess over scalable systems that let our commercial teams fly. We’re a remote-first, globally distributed team that values directness, low ego, and big impact. If you want to build meaningful things without layers of bureaucracy, you’re in the right place.
## About the Role
We’re looking for a Salesforce Developer to join our growing Salesforce team, working alongside our existing developer and RevOps. We’ve completed our migration from HubSpot to Salesforce, and the focus now is on making our new instance the single home for our commercial processes and tooling. You’ll consolidate and harden what we’ve built, retire legacy tools into Salesforce, and help shape what comes next: deeper Sales Cloud capability, exploring Service Cloud and Marketing Cloud, and putting Salesforce’s newer AI features, including Agentforce, to real use.
## What would YOU be doing?
Consolidate processes and tooling into Salesforce, replacing point solutions and manual workarounds with flows, Apex and native features
Build and maintain Sales Cloud improvements: lead and opportunity automation, routing and round-robin, stage gates, Lightning pages and LWCs
Prototype and deliver Agentforce and AI use cases with RevOps, such as rep assistants, next-best-action and record summaries
Support the exploration and rollout of Service Cloud (e.g. Cases for onboarding and support processes) and Marketing Cloud

Maintain integrations with our GTM stack (Snowflake, Gong, Customer.io, Shopify), working with our data engineering team to keep data clean after the migration
Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer and Supplier-facing teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions
Take part in sprint planning, effort estimation and prioritisation, and deliver on sprint commitments
Work a shared sprint backlog with our other Salesforce developer: peer-review code, share on-call bug fixing, and keep documentation current
Document everything you build — create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation to ensure smooth handovers and maintainability
## What do we need from YOU?
Salesforce Platform Developer I certification (essential)
Strong Apex coding skills — you write clean, efficient, well-documented code
Solid SQL skills and ability to build and map APIs and integrations
2–5 years of Salesforce development experience, ideally in a scaling company
Confident with Flow, LWC, SOQL and the Salesforce deployment lifecycle (sandboxes, change sets or SFDX, version control)
Strong Sales Cloud experience; exposure to Service Cloud or Marketing Cloud a plus
Self-motivated with a strategic mindset — you identify problems before they become fires
Collaborative: comfortable sharing a codebase, reviewing others’ work and taking feedback
Strong documentation habits — you leave things better than you found them

Salesforce Platform Developer II, Service Cloud or Marketing Cloud certifications
Experience in marketplace, e-commerce, or SaaS businesses
Background in companies at Series A–D stage where you’ve built things from scratch
Experience with Snowflake or similar data warehousing tools
Experience stabilising or consolidating an org after a CRM migration
Hands-on experience with Agentforce, Einstein or Prompt Builder
## Our culture and what we offer
At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We are convinced that employees need to find alignment between their inner values and their company’s culture and mission to unlock their full potential. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning and growth where everyone can bring expertise, own projects and easily measure their impact.
Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company.
Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment.
Engage in intellectually challenging work that contributes significantly to Nivoda’s success and scalability.
## Our benefits

💻 Remote work
🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning
🏖️ Unlimited holiday allowance
🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase

title: AI Engineer - Full time
description:
TLDR; Davis is hiring an AI Engineer to work on the multi-agent pipeline turning raw, fragmented data into expert-grade real estate deliverables. You will make it more reliable, fast, and indistinguishable from the best human teams, then push it past what any human team could do, owning the stack end to end, from context engineering and orchestration to verification, storage and evaluation.
## About Davis
Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.
We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.
We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.
## Where We Operate
Early-stage development starts with a chain of high-stakes decisions, each requiring different data, different expertise, and different deliverables. Today, we deliver AI-powered outputs across the full spectrum - site sourcing, feasibility studies, architectural design, investment analysis, financial modeling, dataroom analysis, and more.
## The Role
You will work on one of the core systems behind what Davis delivers. Our agents take raw, fragmented data and turn it into deliverables that real estate professionals use to make high-stakes decisions. Your job is to make that pipeline reliable, fast, and indistinguishable from work done by the best human teams - then push it beyond what any human team could do.
You can expect to:
Build and operate multi-agent systems that turn heterogeneous data into expert-grade deliverables across real estate development workflows.
Own the system end to end: infra, orchestration, context engineering, how the system selects, structures, and injects the right information so agents behave reliably at scale.
Ensure production-grade quality, performance, and reliability across every output we deliver to clients.
Sit with clients and domain experts regularly to understand their constraints, challenge your own assumptions, and make sure every output meets and even exceeds clients' expectations.
Beyond the technical depth, this role will expose you to how real estate decisions are made, how clients think, and what it takes to deliver outputs they trust. You'll develop a sharp business intuition alongside your engineering skills.
## Key Responsibilities
Harness engineering: design and build the system layer around the model - context assembly, tool orchestration, verification, and report generation - to deliver consistent, high-quality outputs at scale.
Data ingestion & context assembly: handle messy, unstructured project data from heterogeneous sources and ensure agents have the right context at all times.
Storage & traceability: persist sources, extracted facts, intermediate results, report versions, and expert edits.
Expert-in-the-loop UX: design and build the review experience (annotations, edits, approvals, diffs/version history, provenance display).
Evaluation & benchmarking: build an internal eval harness (datasets, rubrics, regression tests, monitoring) to track agents performance over time.
## What We're Looking For
1.5+ years building and deploying production software at scale (APIs, reliability, testing, performance).
Experience building and evaluating LLM agents / multi-step workflows in real systems.
Proven context engineering experience: you've built systems where reliability depends on assembling the right context (RAG over heterogeneous sources, summarization, conversation state, tool outputs).
Deep Python expertise (clean architecture, typing, async/concurrency, strong testing culture).
Strong experience with databases + data modeling (structured storage, document storage, versioning).
Full-stack experience (you can ship a real UI), with a clear backend emphasis.
Comfortable building from first principles: we don't want heavy agent frameworks — we prefer a lightweight, well-engineered codebase.
## Nice to Have
Experience operating LLM systems with observability and quality monitoring in production.
GIS familiarity (parcels, zoning layers, geocoding).
Multi-country product experience (heterogeneous sources, localization, varying rules).
NLP background
## Why Join Us
You're joining a team of 9 at the very beginning - where every decision you make shapes the product, the culture, and the trajectory of the company. What you build here will be yours.
Direct impact on growth: your work doesn't sit behind three layers of review. You ship, clients use it, and you see the results. Every output you improve translates directly into revenue and reputation.
Real-world impact: your work supports investment decisions, accelerates development timelines, and helps redefine how cities are imagined, designed, and built.
High ownership: own the full feasibility stack end to end, as the CEO of that part.
Competitive salary and meaningful equity in an early-stage company.
A small team with high standards - we ship fast and love working together.
## More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:
## Team
Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.
Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.
We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.
## Why We'll Win
Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.
Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.
## Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design Yet
Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability; parametric tools only check constraints after generation, leading to designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.
Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but doesn't yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. description:
TLDR; Davis is hiring an AI Researcher to push the frontier of floorplan generation. Working directly with architects, you'll own research directions end-to-end, from diffusion and flow matching models (continuous and discrete) to deployment in a product used by real estate professionals.
## About Davis
Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.
We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.
We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.
## Our Mission
We build a foundation model for architectural design that generates compliant, editable building layouts from scratch. By leveraging discrete diffusion models (operating on structured representations rather than pixels), we aim to produce floorplans and site plans that respect real-world constraints (zoning laws, space requirements, etc.) and can be iteratively refined like a human-designed plan.
## The Role
We are looking for a AI Researcher to lead this effort in our Paris office. If you’re excited about improving our current state-of-the-art floorplan generative model and applying it to a high-impact domain, this role offers a unique opportunity to define a new class of AI-driven design tools. You will work within a focused team of 3–4 engineers and researchers, collaborating daily with architects to turn foundational research into deployable tools.
What you'll own:
Model Architecture & Design Space: Design the core model architecture and work on a discrete design space for architectural layouts. You will choose how to represent floorplans (e.g. as graphs of rooms/connections or token grids) such that the diffusion model’s outputs are editable and code-compliant by construction. This involves ensuring the model can enforce architectural rules (e.g. room sizes, adjacency constraints) within its generation process.
Large-Scale Model Training: Lead the training of a foundation diffusion model from scratch on GPU clusters. You’ll set up distributed training across multiple nodes, optimize data loading and checkpointing, and manage experiments at scale. The role requires hands-on engineering for efficient training of large models on high-performance computing infrastructure.
Benchmarking & Iteration: Evaluate the model’s performance and establish benchmarks to measure success. Using these evaluations, you’ll iterate on the model to push performance beyond existing methods. Our goal is to surpass the latest research results and produce genuinely useful architectural designs.
## What We’re Looking For
Applied Research Excellence: PhD or Master’s in Maths, Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Strong foundations in ML and a track record of innovative research, publications, or high-impact projects.
Diffusion Model Expertise: Deep understanding of diffusion models (discrete or continuous), guided generation techniques, and the latest advances in generative modeling.
Large-Scale Model Training: Proven experience training large-scale deep learning models on GPU clusters. Comfortable with distributed training, multi-node jobs, experiment management, and handling large datasets.
Technical Engineering Skills: Proficiency in Python with experience in PyTorch or similar frameworks. Ability to write efficient, maintainable code and optimize training pipelines. Familiarity with distributed training libraries (e.g., PyTorch Lightning) is a plus.
Research Literacy: Ability to read, evaluate, and implement advanced ML research. You stay current with state-of-the-art generative modeling work and can adapt cutting-edge methods to domain-specific problems.
Collaboration & Communication: Strong teamwork skills. Able to articulate complex concepts clearly and work closely with AI engineers, researchers, and domain experts to integrate technical solutions into the architectural design workflow.
## Nice to Have
Industry Experience: Background in a top AI research organization or cutting-edge startup, especially working on foundation models or generative AI tools.
Publications/Open Source: Research publications in generative modeling (diffusion, VAEs, flows, GANs) or significant open-source contributions demonstrating ability to push state-of-the-art systems.
Domain Knowledge: While not required, an interest in architecture or design will help.
Reinforcement Learning & Optimization: Experience with RL, reward modeling, or constrained optimization (particularly MCTS, GRPO and RLHF) relevant to guiding generative models under complex constraints.
Multimodal Generation: Experience with graph-based, sequence-based, or discrete structured generative models (e.g., molecule generation, layout generation, program synthesis) or with graph neural networks.
## Why Join Us
You're joining a team of 12 at the very beginning - where every decision you make shapes the product, the culture, and the trajectory of the company. What you build here will be yours.
Build what no one has before: the foundation model that automates architectural design and redefines how cities are imagined, designed, and built.
Work on meaningful challenges: from constraint-aware generative models to real-world deployment in major construction projects.
Competitive salary and meaningful equity in an early-stage company.
Ship fast, iterate boldly: go from research to prototype to production in weeks, not years.
Join a world-class team: a mix of AI researchers, engineers, and architects backed by world-class VCs.
## More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:
## Team
Mehdi (CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.
Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.
We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.
## Why We'll Win
Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.
Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.
## Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design Yet
Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability; parametric tools only check constraints after generation, leading to designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.
Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but doesn't yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. As a result, floorplans may “look” plausible but break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they're usable.

title: ML Hydrologist, Flood Forecasting
description:
About the Role
Global ML flood models now outperform traditional approaches on large rivers, but they still break down in the small, fast catchments where flash floods happen. Riverkin, a VC-backed ETH Zürich Spin-off, is closing that gap. We start from hydrological models trained across thousands of catchments worldwide and make them accurate locally, using a sensor network we deploy ourselves in exactly the places public datasets don't reach.
We are looking for an ML hydrologist to own that work. You will report to the CTO and work directly with our other hydrologist, who covers rainfall radar and short-term nowcasting.
Why this is interesting
Data nobody else has: Our own field-deployed sensors give you live streamflow observations in small, previously ungauged catchments.
An open problem: Whether large-sample models can be made reliable at flash-flood scale is unsolved, and you would be working on it with real data and real users.
Built to protect lives and critical infrastructure: Your models will power early flood warning systems safeguarding hydropower plants and giving first responders more time to protect communities
Publishing and open source: We encourage publishing results and contributing to open tools such as NeuralHydrology and Caravan.
Compute: GPU resources are available for training and experimentation.
What You'll Do
Bring global flood models to the local scale
Take state-of-the-art hydrological ML models (LSTMs, Transformers) trained on large-sample datasets and adapt them to the catchments our customers care about.
Use our own sensor data alongside public gauge, reanalysis and radar data to fine-tune and validate those models locally.
Tackle prediction in ungauged and data-scarce basins through transfer learning and regionalisation.
Own hydrological modelling end to end: set the technical direction, decide when to adapt pre-trained models or train our own, and lead the work from experimentation through validation to production.
Work as one modelling team
Make practical trade-offs between forecast accuracy, model complexity and development effort to build a reliable product that meets customer needs.
Work side by side with our hydrologist specialising in rainfall radar and nowcasting to directly integrate rainfall nowcasts into your flood models.
Work with software engineers to put models into production and monitor their performance.
Identify and test advances in ML flood forecasting, turning promising research into more accurate and reliable forecasts for our customers.
Stay close to the real world
We believe the best modellers understand the world behind their models. We encourage you to join field deployments and customer conversations to build that understanding firsthand.
You are an opinionated contributor to key technical decisions.
Who You Are
You’ve built and validated hydrological ML models across many catchments and have experience taking modelling work into real-world use.
You combine scientific rigour with product judgement: you test assumptions, understand uncertainty and focus on improvements that matter to customers.
You take ownership from an open question to a working solution. You set priorities, make decisions and keep moving without waiting for perfect information.
You care deeply about the quality of your work. You dig into why models fail, follow problems through and stay invested in how your forecasts perform after deployment.
You communicate clearly in writing and in person, can explain your reasoning and trade-offs, and work closely with people across hydrology, software, hardware and field operations.
Technical Requirements
Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning ML streamflow or flood models across many catchments at once (regional, continental or global), for example on CAMELS or Caravan. Experience with single-catchment models alone is not sufficient.
Experience transferring such models to new or data-scarce catchments through fine-tuning, regionalisation, or prediction in ungauged basins.
Strong understanding of rainfall-runoff processes and the limitations of hydrological observations and input data.
Experience validating models across unseen catchments and time periods, including assessing flood-peak magnitude, timing and predictive uncertainty.
Strong Python skills, with experience writing maintainable code for data processing, modelling and reproducible experiments.
Practical depth in deep learning for time series, including developing, training and debugging models in PyTorch or a comparable framework.
MSc or PhD in hydrology, water resources, atmospheric sciences, machine learning, or equivalent.
Nice to Have
Publications or open-source work on large-sample hydrology, transfer learning, or ungauged-basin prediction.
Experience with NeuralHydrology, ERA5 or similar global forcing datasets.
Experience with sub-daily or event-based flood modelling.
Experience processing large hydrometeorological datasets with tools such as xarray and Dask, and formats such as Zarr.
Previous early startup experience.
Role Details
Contract: Permanent, full-time (100% FTE).
Start date: immediately
Reports to: CTO.
Compensation: Commensurate with experience + equity
Growth: a key early hire with the opportunity to shape Riverkin's flood modelling as the team grows.
Location: Four days per week in our Zurich office and one day working from home.
Work authorisation: Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit, is required.
Working language: English. German is not required.
About Riverkin
We are a well-capitalized Swiss startup building real-time sensing and data infrastructure for rivers. Our own field-deployed sensors collect live water-level and sediment data, while our platform turns that data into decision-ready insights for customers. We work directly with the hydropower sector, where predicting flash floods is needed for daily operations. As we prove ourselves in this field, we will move towards the first responders market. We are a small, hands-on team working across hydrology, hardware, field engineering, software and market development.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Gen AI)
description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a talented and versatile Full Stack Engineer to join our Gen AI team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining both front-end and back-end components of our Gen AI applications, including RAG chatbots, agentic AI systems, and film classification platforms. Your expertise in full stack development, cloud-based AI services, and quality assurance will be crucial in bringing cutting-edge AI technologies—including autonomous AI agents—to life through intuitive and efficient web applications.
Key Initiatives
AI Assistant Platform
• Built on AWS Bedrock with multi-cloud integration (GCP and Azure)
• Supports Gemini and OpenAI models
• Frontend development using TypeScript and Next.js
• Multi-cloud architecture requiring seamless integration across AWS, GCP, and Azure services
Film Classification System
• Built on GCP's Agentic framework
• Utilises Gemini models with multi-agent architecture
• Backend development using Python
• Advanced agentic AI workflows for automated film content analysis
Key Responsibilities
• Development Responsibilities: Full Stack Development: Design, develop, and maintain both front-end and back-end components of Gen AI applications, ensuring seamless integration between user interfaces and LLM-powered backends.
• Cloud-Native Development: Architect and implement cloud-native solutions leveraging AWS, GCP, and Azure services, with particular focus on AI/ML services across these platforms.
• LLM Integration: Implement APIs and services to integrate Large Language Models (including AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, and GCP's Gemini) into web applications, focusing on efficient data flow and real-time processing of model outputs.
• Agentic AI Development: Build and maintain autonomous AI agent systems capable of multi-step reasoning, planning, and decision-making. Implement agent orchestration frameworks that enable AI agents to use tools, access external APIs, and execute complex workflows.
• Agent Tool Integration: Develop and integrate tool-calling capabilities for AI agents, enabling them to interact with external systems, databases, and APIs to accomplish user-defined goals autonomously.
• User Interface Design: Create intuitive and responsive user interfaces for Gen AI applications, with a focus on enhancing user experience in chatbot interactions, agentic AI workflows, and film classification interfaces.
• Database Management: Design and maintain databases to store and retrieve data efficiently for Gen AI applications, including user interactions, model outputs, agent execution logs, and system state management.
• Performance Optimisation: Optimise application performance, focusing on reducing latency in LLM-powered features, agent execution times, and ensuring smooth user experiences even under high loads.
• Security Implementation: Implement robust security measures to protect sensitive data and ensure compliance with data protection regulations, particularly for AI-driven applications handling user inputs and autonomous agent actions.
• DevOps and Deployment: Participate in CI/CD pipeline setup and maintenance, ensuring smooth deployment of Gen AI applications across different cloud environments.
• Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation for codebases, APIs, agent workflows, and system architectures to facilitate knowledge sharing and future development.
Testing & Quality Assurance Responsibilities:
• LLM Testing & Validation: Design and execute comprehensive test cases to evaluate the accuracy, reliability, and performance of LLMs integrated into Gen AI applications. Verify that model responses are relevant, contextually appropriate, and factually correct.
• Hallucination Identification: Focus on detecting hallucinations where the model produces false or fabricated information, ensuring these are promptly identified and addressed. Help refine models to reduce these occurrences.
• Accuracy & Quality Assurance: Assess the accuracy of model outputs, especially in high-precision contexts like chatbot conversations or film classification, ensuring that LLMs produce responses that are both relevant and correct according to predefined business logic.
• Test Automation for LLMs: Implement automated testing for common use cases, edge cases, and regression tests, especially focusing on cases that tend to trigger hallucinations or inaccuracies in the model's responses.
• Functional & Non-Functional Testing: Evaluate the LLM's functionality in different scenarios to check if it meets functional requirements. Perform non-functional testing like performance, load, and stress tests to assess the scalability of LLMs when handling high loads or multiple queries.
• Testing and Debugging: Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests for both front-end and back-end components, with a focus on identifying and resolving issues related to LLM integrations, agent behaviour, hallucinations, and inaccurate outputs.
• Bug Reporting & Issue Resolution: Identify and document bugs related to hallucinations, inaccurate outputs, or unexpected model behaviors. Work closely with data scientists and developers to resolve issues and refine models.
• Regression Testing: Ensure that model updates, fine-tuning, or new training data do not introduce regressions or increase hallucinations and inaccuracies. Perform retesting of fixed issues and reassess model accuracy after updates.
Your Future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and certification programs. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.
Who you are
You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
Required Skills & Qualifications
• Strong experience in AWS cloud services, including:
• AWS Bedrock for foundation model deployment
• Core AWS services (EC2, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, etc.)
• AWS security and IAM best practices
• Working knowledge of GCP and Azure, with ability to:
• Navigate and utilise services across multiple cloud platforms
• Implement multi-cloud integration strategies
• Understand platform-specific AI/ML services
• Hands-on experience with cloud-based AI services, particularly:
• AWS Bedrock for foundation model access and deployment
• Azure OpenAI Service for GPT model integration
• GCP's Gemini models and Vertex AI platform

## Job Description
How much can a video of swaying seagrass tell us about the flow around it? Join Asst Prof Jiarui (Gary) Lei’s team in Civil and Environmental Engineering at the National University of Singapore. You will lead the development of visual monitoring methods for the CFI Singapore VASE-R project (V2-P9).
Design wave-flume experiments that pair video of vegetation motion with acoustic Doppler measurements. Develop and test deep learning models that estimate water velocity and turbulence from that motion.
Develop computer vision methods to combine colour and depth (RGB-D) images with LiDAR surveys. Map vegetation structure and bed changes, including scour around mangrove roots and erosion at seagrass patch edges.
Validate flow estimates against flume and field measurements, and bed reconstructions against measured bed profiles. Quantify uncertainty and document the analysis code and field protocols so other teams can repeat the measurements.
Apply through NUS Careers with a CV and a short note on your research interests. For enquiries, contact Asst Prof Gary Lei at jlei@nus.edu.sg.
## Qualifications
• A PhD in engineering, computer science or a related field.
• Strong Python programming and machine learning skills, including experience developing and validating models on measurement data.
• Experience with computer vision for video, depth imagery or 3D point clouds, and the ability to design and communicate a reproducible analysis.
• Familiarity with coastal hydrodynamics, flume experiments, acoustic Doppler measurements or coastal field surveys is desirable.

title: Full Stack Developer (JavaScript, ReactJS, REST APIs) -Mexico Remote
description:
About Ellucian
Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. Fueled by decades of experience with a singular focus on the unique needs of learning institutions, the Ellucian platform features best-in-class SaaS capabilities and delivers insights needed now and into the future. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. Ellucian's innovative solutions, vast ecosystem of partners and user community of more than 45,000 provides best practices leading to greater institutional success and achieving better student outcomes.
About the Opportunity
The Full Stack Developer uses technical, analytical, and consulting skills to support the Ellucian Managed Services client community. The role works directly with customers to understand business and technical needs, troubleshoot application issues, and implement reliable solutions using the tools and resources available.
The work ranges from software troubleshooting and break/fix support to application enhancements, integrations, reporting, and scripting. This is a customer-facing role that requires a strong learning mindset, structured problem solving, clear communication, and effective collaboration across teams.
Prior Higher Education or Ellucian product experience is not required. Successful candidates are expected to learn new business domains, products, and technologies quickly and apply that knowledge to customer needs.
## Where you will make an impact
• Investigate and resolve defined to moderately complex technical issues using a structured troubleshooting approach, established practices, and available documentation and tools.
• Gather information from customers to understand program needs, objectives, business processes, functional requirements, inputs, outputs, and expected outcomes.
• Analyze application behavior, code, logs, API responses, integrations, data, and configuration to identify likely causes of errors and implement appropriate fixes or workarounds.
• Prototype, configure, refine, test, and debug applications, integrations, reports, scripts, and related technical solutions.
• Apply development and programming skills across application tiers to build, modify, and test application changes, interfaces, reports, and scripts.
• Use REST APIs and API clients such as Bruno, Postman, or Insomnia to validate requests, responses, authentication, payloads, and integration behavior.
• Provide high-quality technical consultation and support for Ellucian products and services, including Ethos, Banner Extensibility, Ellucian Experience, Ethos Data Connect, Banner Self-Service, and related solutions.
• Communicate progress, findings, dependencies, and resolution steps clearly to customers and internal teams, including translating technical information for non-technical audiences when needed.
• Escalate issues appropriately when additional expertise is required, providing clear evidence, troubleshooting history, and reproducible details to accelerate resolution.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to complete assignments, resolve customer issues, and meet agreed priorities and service expectations.
• Document technical findings, solutions, and reusable troubleshooting steps to strengthen team knowledge and improve future resolution efficiency.
• Demonstrate customer focus, active listening, adaptability, accountability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new systems and technologies.
## What you will bring
• Typically 2-4 years of relevant experience in application development, technical support, integrations, consulting, or a related technical role.
• Hands-on experience with modern JavaScript technologies such as ReactJS, NodeJS, and ES5/ES6 JavaScript.
• Experience consuming and troubleshooting REST APIs and working with API clients such as Bruno, Postman, or Insomnia.
• Experience with inbound and outbound system integrations and the ability to trace data or transactions across connected systems.

description:

At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. Customer‑facing SRE role designing, operating, and supporting reliable, observable, and cost‑effective platforms across Linux, Kubernetes, and public cloud. You’ll manage workstreams, automate with IaC, improve SLOs/SLIs and alert hygiene, and support peers.

Elasticsearch/OpenSearch

Not the right job for you? Check out what other great jobs Pythian has open around the world! Pythian Careers
What you will be doing:
• Improve reliability, availability, and visibility for customer platforms; plan/execute documented maintenance; drive remediation/automation.

• Manage the full OS lifecycle, including installation, deployment (Kickstart, VMs, containers, bare metal), patching, and upgrades.

Elasticsearch/OpenSearch: cluster ops, shard/replica strategy, ILM/snapshots, performance/security, EFK integration.

• Facilitate technical discussions with customers; advise on platform roadmaps and architecture trade‑offs.
• Support and cross‑train teammates; uphold documentation quality and internal knowledge sharing.
• Participate in on‑call, escalations, and change reviews; proactively reduce toil via scripting/automation.
What we need from you:
Core
• Strong Linux administration/troubleshooting; Kubernetes fundamentals (workloads, networking, storage, upgrades, security, HA); one major cloud (GCP/AWS/Azure).
• IaC + config management experience; CI/CD/GitOps familiarity; scripting with Bash and/or Python.
• Consulting mindset: clear English (written/spoken), estimation, stakeholder communication, documentation quality.
Data Platforms (depth in one; ramp on others)
Elasticsearch/OpenSearch (ops, tuning, ILM/snapshots, security/EFK), or
Redis (OSS/managed operations; data structures, eviction policies, RDB/AOF persistence).
Kafka–Hadoop–Spark (production exposure; Confluent/MSK/Strimzi; Dataproc/EMR/CDP familiarity), or
Nice to have
• Security/IAM basics, budget/capacity awareness; Prometheus/Grafana experience; diagramming/runbook excellence.

Love your work/life balance: Flexibly work remotely from your home, there’s no daily travel requirement to an office! All you need is a stable internet connection.
Love your coworkers: Collaborate with some of the best and brightest in the industry!
Love your development: Hone your skills or learn new ones with our substantial training allowance; participate in professional development days, attend training, become certified, whatever you like!

title: Copywriter, Traditional SEO & AI Search Visibility
description:
## Copywriter, Traditional SEO & AI Search Visibility
Freelance Contract · Remote-first (Canada) · Works with the Head of Advisory
## About podium iq
AI models now decide who gets recommended, considered and chosen. We measure how enterprise brands show up inside those answers, score them against the competitors that actually appear, and turn the finding into a content plan. Then we ship the content. Most of this category stops at the dashboard - we don’t, which is why our clients are financial institutions, global consumer technology brands, national regulating bodies, and major consulting firms.
## The role
We’re building a roster of freelance writers we tap as enterprise work comes in.
Every brief you receive traces back to a specific opportunity podium found: a query where our client is invisible, a competitor winning a comparison, a topic with citation authority sitting unclaimed. You’ll know the target queries, the intent, the structure, and the sources before you start. What the brief can’t give you is the judgment, and that’s what we’re hiring.
You'll write for brands whose customers are making real decisions about money, technology, and the things they care about. Some briefs need nothing more than your craft. Others need you to go find the answer, interview a subject matter expert, or dive into secondary research until the content has something worth saying.
What you'll do
Write website copy, articles, FAQs, and supporting content from platform-derived briefs, built to be found in search and cited in AI answers.
Interrogate the brief before you write it. If the angle is wrong or the source material is thin, say so early.
Research properly. Read the client's material, understand their market, and get to the substance underneath the query.
Interview client subject matter experts when a piece needs primary insight, and occasionally walk a client through your work.
Work with our strategists on sprint timelines, turning quality around at pace.
Own your own quality control. Work arrives ready for client review.
## What you bring
Five or more years writing professionally, with a portfolio that shows range and rigour.
Experience writing for SEO and GEO. You understand search intent, structure, internal linking, and source signals that get content cited in AI answers.
Command of what good actually is. You can explain why a piece works, and you can tell when a draft is competent and forgettable.
Research instinct. You go looking for the specific, the concrete, and the thing nobody else bothered to find out.
Comfort in front of a client. You can run an SME interview and get the good material out of someone who thinks they have nothing to say.
## Speed with judgment intact.
A clear-eyed relationship with AI tooling. Use whatever helps you. What we are looking for underneath it is your own research, your own angle, and the taste to know when a draft has gone generic. That gap is the entire value of hiring a writer right now.
## Where you specialize
We work across sectors and briefs will move you between them. Range across several is rare, depth in one is enough to get on the roster. We're actively looking for depth in:
Consumer financial services. Writing about money for real people, inside regulatory constraints.
Consumer brands and conversion. Writing that carries someone through a decision, from first curiosity to the moment they act, across retail, sport, and consumer products.
B2B and enterprise technology. Writing for buyers who know more than you do about their own problem.
Product marketing. Turning a feature into a reason to care.
## The details
Freelance, project-based, open to writers anywhere in Canada. The rate is $70 to $90 per hour depending on experience, location, and specialization.
Roster writers are engaged per project as enterprise work comes in, so we don’t guarantee volume or ask for exclusivity. What we commit to a clear brief, a fair rate, fast decisions, and clarity about what’s coming. What we expect from those we onboard is accountability to the deadline and to the standard, without supervision. Sound like you? Here’s how to apply.
## Send us:
Two pieces of work you are proud of that also performed. Rankings, traffic, citations, conversions, or other business metrics.
A short note on one of them: what you went and found out that made it better.
An overview of the sectors your specialize in and number of years experience writing in those fields

## About Tailscale
Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.
## About the Role
We’re seeking a skilled and diligent full-time Software Engineer to join our growing team. You will work as part of the Dataplane Engineering Team to:
• Contribute to the core client connectivity features of Tailscale by applying a deep understanding of network engineering and software development.
• Evolve and enhance the Tailscale connectivity offerings between clients, subnet routers, exit nodes and other integrations with customer network infrastructure.
• Provide architectural insights and resolve escalated customer network issues to fix complex connectivity problems.
• Collaborate with product management and internal engineering to develop integrated network solutions that prioritize scalability and ease of maintenance while ensuring a superior customer experience.
Because we’re an early-stage and fully remote company, we’re looking for a strongly motivated individual who can help move the product forward. The ability to think on your feet, collaborate with highly technical teams, and comfort working asynchronously are essential.

• Advance product features by building upon or merging established industry network protocols with Tailscale's specific designs and frameworks.

• Evaluate and optimize the performance, reliability, and scale of our software across a wide array of technical platforms and hardware.
• Provide expert consultation and support the customer success teams with critical network escalations within key customer environments.
• Engage actively with the open-source community and contribute to relevant projects.

• Significant experience with networking software and diagnosing networking issues

• Proficiency in Go or other low-level languages (e.g. C/C++, Rust), including a strong grasp of concurrent programming and techniques for optimizing performance.
• Experience with large scale distributed systems is highly desirable
• Knowledge of low-level OS network stacks is highly desirable
• Ability to give and process constructive feedback, as well as work independently
